runes: ᚬᛋᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛏᚢᚠᛋ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛅᚢᚠᛏ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬

norse: §A "Ôzurr "Stúfs sonr §B reisti stein þenna ept "Bróður, son sinn.
english: §A Ôzurr, Stúfr's son, §B raised this stone in memory of Bróðir, his son.
... these runes ... long live.
I Hlewagastiz Holtijaz (of Holt, Holti's son) made the horn.

runes: ᚬᛋᚴᛅᛏᛚᛅ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛭ ᛚᛋ ᛭ ᛋᛒᛅᚴᛅ ᛭ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛭ ᛬
translit: oskatla × risþi × ls × sbaka × sun × stin × þonsi × ÷
english: Áskatla raised this stone ... ...-gísl, Spaki's son.

runes: ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᚵᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛏᚢᚴᛅ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚾᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛘᚢᛚᛅ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚱᚦᚬ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚦᚱᚢ ᛬ ᚦᛁᚾ ᛬

norse: "Þorgeirr "Tóka sonr reisti stein þenna eptir "Múla, bróður sinn, harða góðan þegn.
english: Þorgeirr Tóki's son raised this stone in memory of Múli, his brother, a very good þegn.

runes: ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛅᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢ ᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬

english: Þórir raised this stone in memory of Gunnarr, his father.

runes: ᛏᚢᚴᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚢᚠᛚᛅ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚱᚦᛅ ᛬ ᚴᚢ ᚦᛅᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛁᚵᚾ ᛬

english: §A Tóki placed this stone in memory of Óflar/Ýfli, his father, a very good §B þegn.

runes: ᛬ ᚼᛅᛚᛅ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏ ᛬ ᚬᛋᛚᚠ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬

norse: "Hella(?) reisti stein þenna, "Léttu sonr, ept "Ásulf/"Ásleif, bróður sinn.
english: Hella(?), Létta's(?) son, raised this stone in memory of Ásulfr/Ásleifr, his brother.

runes: ᛏᚢᚠᛁ ᛬ ᚴᛁᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛁ ᛬ ᚠᛁᛚᛅᚴᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚠᚢᛋᛏᚱᛅ ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᚴᚾᚢᛋ

english: Tófi Gedda's son placed ..., his partner, Þorgnýr's foster-son.

english: Þorsteinn raised this stone in memory of Eygoti and <i-al> father ... <kuþ-> runes.

translit: : þuriR : risþi : stin : þoasi : aufti : karl : hin : kuþoa : fRlaka : sin : harþ a : kuþoan : trRk :
norse: "Þórir reisti stein þenna eptir "Karl hinn "Góða, félaga sinn, harða góðan dreng.
english: Þórir raised this stone in memory of Karl the good, his partner, a very good valiant man.

runes: ᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛅᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᛏᚢᚴᛅ ᚾ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚦᛅᚾ ᛭

english: ... this stone in memory of Tóki ... good.
'alu' (ale?)

runes: ᚴᛅᛚᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏ ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛁᚾ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᛅ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚦ ᛅ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚦᚬᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛁᚵᚾ ᛬

norse: "Kali setti stein þenna ept "Þorstein, fôður sinn, harða góðan þegn.
english: Kali placed this stone in memory of Þorsteinn, his father, a very good þegn.

translit: : osur : sati : stin : þonsi : aft : ual:tuka : trutin : × sin × stin : kuask : hirsi : stonta : loki : saR : ual:tuka × × uarþa : nafni
norse: §A "Ôzurr setti stein þenna ept "Valtóka, dróttin sinn. §B Steinn kveðsk hérsi standa lengi, sá "Valtóka varða nefni.
english: §A Ôzurr placed this stone in memory of Valtóki, his lord. §B The stone proclaims that it will long stand here; it will name Valtóki's cairn.

runes: ᚦᚢᚱᚴᛅᛚ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᛅ ᛬ ᛅᚠᛏ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬

english: Þorkell placed the stone in memory of ... son, his father.

english: Þyrvé and Óðinkárr and Guðmundr, mother and sons, these three raised these monuments in memory of ... the <huþska>, he was the first and best of landholders in Denmark.

english: Ôzurr Estate-steward, Køgir's(?) son, carved these runes in memory of (his) lady Ásboð/Ásmóð.
Pétr.

Ketill Urni lies here.
... Ônundr(?) in memory of his beloved/his wife(?).

norse: §A "Tóki reisti steina þessa ok gerði kuml þessi ept "Apa/"Ebba, mág sinn, þegn góðan, ok §B "Tófu, móður sína. Þau liggja bæði í þeim haugi. "Api/"Ebbi unni "Tóka fjár síns ept sik.
english: §A Tóki raised these stones and made these monuments in memory of Api/Ebbi, his kinsman-by-marriage, a good þegn, and §B Tófa, his mother. Both of them lie in this mound. Api/Ebbi granted Tóki his wealth after himself.

runes: ᛅᚢᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚦᚬᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛅᛒᛏ ᛫ ᚬᛋᚢᛚᛒ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫

english: Eysteinn placed this stone in memory of Ásulfr, his father.

Herjulfr.

runes: ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᛘᚢᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚱ ᛬ ᚦᛁᛋ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚴᚢᚦᚱ ᛬ ᛬ ᚦᛁᛋ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚴᚢᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ

english: §A Þormóðr raised ... §BP ... these in memory of ... his, a good ... §BQ ... these in memory of ... -góðr ... his father.
Þorgautr.

Geirr.

Eiríkr's monument.

english: Bróðir raised this stone in memory of Bósi, his brother, a very good valiant man.

english: Saxi placed this stone in memory of Ásbjôrn Tófi's/Tóki's son, his partner. He did not flee at Uppsala, but slaughtered as long as he had a weapon.

norse: Þetta er sankti "Gabriel ok sagði sankta "María, at hon skuldi barn fœða. Þetta er "Elisabet ok "María ok heilsask. Hér hvílisk "María, sem hon barn fœddi, skapara himins ok jarðar, sem oss leysti. Þetta eru þeir þrír konungar, sem fyrst gerðu offr várum dróttni. Hér tók hann viðr konunga offri, várr dróttinn. Hér riðu þeir burt þrír konungar, síðan þeir offrat [haf]a várum dróttni. Þá er þat hér fram s[ôg]u(?). Júðar tóku várn dróttin ok [bu]nd[u] [ha]nn við[r t]ré ok gættu. Síðan leiddu þeir hann burt þaðan bundinn, ok negldu hér júðar "Jésús á kross. Sé fram á þetta. "Sigreifr mei[st]a[r]i.
english: This is Saint Gabriel and he said to Saint Mary that she would bear a child. These are Elisabeth and Mary and they greet each other. Here Mary rests, as she bore the child, Creator of Heaven and Earth, who redeemed us. These are the Three Kings, who first made offerings to Our Lord. Here He accepted the Kings' offerings, Our Lord. Here the Three Kings rode away, after they had made offerings to Our Lord. Then it is this far in the story(?). Jews took Our Lord and bound him to a tree and protected him. Then they led him away bound from there, and here the Jews nailed Jesus to the cross. Look ahead to this. Master Sigreifr.

norse: Coniuro vos, septem sorores ... ... "Elffrica(?) "Affricca, "Soria, "Affoca, "Affricala. Coniuro vos et contestor per patrem et filium et spiritum sanctum, ut non noceatis istam famulum "Dei, neque in occulis neque in membris, neque in medullis, nec in ullo comp[ag]ine membrorum eius, ut inhabitat in te virtus "Christi altissimi. Ecce crucem Domini, fugite partes adverse, vicit leo de tribu "Juda, radi{x} "David. In nomine patris et filii et spiritus sancti, amen. "Christus vincit "Christus regnat "Christus imperat, "Christus liberat, "Christus te/et benedicit, ab omni malo defendat. Agla. Pater noster. ...
english: I invoke you, seven sisters ... Elffrica(?) Affricca, Soria, Affoca, Affricala. I invoke and call you to witness through the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, that you do not harm this servant of God, neither in the eyes nor in the limbs nor in the marrow nor in any joint of his limbs, that the power of Christ Most High shall reside in you. Behold the cross of the Lord; flee, you hostile powers. The lion of the tribe of Juda, the root of David, has conquered. In the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, Amen. Christ conquers, Christ reigns, Christ rules, Christ liberates, Christ blesses you, defends you from all evil. Agla (= Thou art strong in eternity, Lord). Our Father. ...

norse: Þenna stein þá lét húsfreyja "Hróðvé gera yfir sinn bónda "Jakob í "Managôrðum/"Mannegårde, sem skotin varð ihel með ein byrsustein af "Visborg, þá en konungr "Eiríkr var bestallað á því fornefnda slot. En þá var liðit af "Guðs byrð fjórtán hundrað ár ok einu ári minna en fimtigi ár. Biðjum þet at "Guð náði hans sál ok ôllum kristnum sálum. Amen.
english: Housewife Hróðvé had this stone made over her husbandman Jakobr in Managarðir/Mannegård, who was shot to pieces with a gun at Visborg, when King Eiríkr was stationed at the aforementioned castle. And then fourteen hundred years and one year less than fifty years had passed since God's birth. Let us pray that God be gracious to his soul and to all Christian souls. Amen.

norse: Þau létu gera limning þessa fyrir "Líknviðar sál ok fyrir "Bótliknar sál, tveggja systkina sálir. "Hallvarðr gerði. Hann er skyldr minnas þeira.
english: They had this painting made for Líknviðr's soul and for Bótlikn's soul, two fortunate sisterlings. Hallvarr made. He is obliged to remember them.
invitation

english: ... Hróarr(?) ... soul, both father and son. Auðhvatr/Auðvaldr made this vault. Geirvaldr in Vestkindr/Väskinde carved.

Hail Mary, full of grace.

english: This (is placed) in memory of Heilfúss(?) He died at home and owned (= had) one daughter. She is called Heilvé. Uddr of Valdinga made the stones and he funded the monument. Dan and Bótbjôrn carved.
... and ... the vault ...

norse: "Ólafr lét gera stein ... ôllum himinríki. Amen.
english: Ólafr had the stone made ... all the heavens. Amen.
Bótviðr of Alskóg owns me.

norse: "Jakobr ok "Hróðl[ík]n(?) létu gera þenna stein eptir "Aldvið, sinn son.
english: Jakobr and Hróðlíkn(?) had this stone made in memory of Aldviðr, their son.

translit: butuiþer i akebu biþin : firir : allum : kristnum : sialum herra ÷ iuan ÷ lundi : han atti : mik : um : tiu : aar
norse: §A "Bótviðr í "Eikibý/"Ekebys. §B Biðið fyrir ôllum kristnum sálum. §C Herra "Jóhan "Lundi/"Lunde, hann átti mik um tíu ár.
english: §A Bótviðr in Eikibýr/Ekebys. §B Pray for all Christian souls. §C Sire Jóhan Lundi/Lunde, he owned me for ten years.
Folkviðr ...
Geirvaldr made the iron on the the door.
... Skjaldar(?) and Isakr and(?) ...

translit: hier huili kairuatr : a t oa o lir þ a h o k kairuatr u ri ok tir han kuam firi kununk ok irkibiskub ok oarn biskub l ir so uilti kuþ hanum l so laku uar stankar sum þors uar sunut hr ok lahr bri þi o
norse: §A Hér hvíli[sk] "Geirhvatr ... §B ... §C ... §D "Geirhvatr ... hann kvam fyrir konung ok erkibiskup ok várn biskup ... Svá vildi "Guð honum [ve]l(?). Svá langu var stankar(?) sem þurs var §E sunnud[a]gr ok lôgr prí[ma]ði. §F ...
english: §A Here rests Geirhvatr ... §B ... §C ... §D Geirhvatr ... he came before the king and the archbishop and our bishop ... Thus God wished him well. The years of misery were so long, when Giant was §E the Sunday[-stave] and Water the prime-stave. §F ...

english: §A Hvatr, Hvatr, Hvatr §B Benedikter §C Jakobr the Tailor §D Arngísl ...
... his/her father ...

norse: "Ól[a]fr ... létu gera stein þenna yfir sinn son "Bótgei[r](?) ... [m]óður "Hróðvé[u] ... pat[e]rnos[te]r fyrir þeira sál ... ...
english: Ólafr ... had this stone made over their son Bótgeirr(?) ... mother Hróðvé ... Our Father for their souls ...
Jóhan <h> <r>

runes: ᛭ ᛁᚢᛅᚾ ᚢᚴ ᛒᚢᛏᛅᛁᚱ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚵᛁᛅᚱᛅ ᚴᛁᛅᛚᛂᚱᛅ ᛬ ᛒᚬᛏᛘᚢᚾᛑᚱ ᛘᛅᛁᛋᛏᛂᚱᛁ ᛬ ᛅᚠ ᛋᛁᛅᚢᚾᛅᛁᛘ ᛫ ᚵᛁᛅᚱᚧᛁ ᛘᛁᚴ
translit: + iuan uk butair : litu giara kiaLera : botmundr maisteri : af siaunaim · giarði mik
norse: "Jóhan ok "Bótgeirr létu gera kjallara. "Bótmundr meistari af "Sjónheim/"Sjonhem gerði mik.
english: Jóhan and Bótgeirr had the cellar made. Master Bótmundr of Sjónheimr/Sjonhem made me.

translit: :+: miþ naþum guz : roþualdr : af · hundingium : hafr : fiavit : da : dail : fyri : sin : sial : ok : sinz : faþur : sial : ok : aluaz : sial :
norse: Með náðum "Guðs. "Hróðvaldr af "Hundingjum/"Hunninge hefr gefit [tíun]da deil fyrir sinni sál ok síns fôður sál ok "Hallhvats sál.
english: With the grace of God. Hróðvaldr of Hundingjum/Hunninge has given a tenth part for his soul and his father's soul and Hallhvatr's soul.
... Sire Jakobr's mother and Hegviðr.

runes: ᛭ ᛁᚢᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛘᛁᚧᚱᛁᚾᚾ ᛬ ᚵᛅᚾᚢᛁᚧᛅ᛬ᛅᚱᚡᛁ ᛬ ᚢᛁᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚱᛁᚧᛅ᛬ᚾᛂᛋ ᛬ ᛒᛁᚦᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛒᚤᚾ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᛒᛅᛚᛁᚱ ᛬ ᚾᚬᛋᛏᚱᚢ ᛬ ᚠᛁᚱᛁ ᛬ ᚦᛅᛁᚱᛅ ᛬ ᛋ
translit: + iuan : smiðrinn : ganuiða:arvi : uiþr : riða:nes : biþin : byn : ok : balir : nostru : firi : þaira : s
norse: "Jóhan, smiðrinn, "Gagnviðararfa/"Gannarve viðr "Riðanes/"Ridanäs. Biðið bœn ok pater noster fyrir þeira s[álum](?)
english: Jóhan the smith, of Gagnviðararfr/Gannarve at Riðanes/Ridanäs. Pray a prayer and Our Father for their souls.

translit: + gesus kristus naþ : botuiþa : sial : k l u u til byna
english: May Jesus Christ be gracious to Bótviðr's soul ... to prayers ...

translit: + gesus : kristus : naþi : auþraifs : sial : af : snoy:krin:t:um : bata : nostar : afi : maria furriir · krisnr : sialir :
norse: "Jésús "Kristus náði "Auðreifs sál af "Snægrindum/"Snögrinde. Pater noster, ave "Maria fyrir kristnir sálir.
english: May Jesus Christ be gracious to Auðreifr of Snægrindr/Snögrinde's soul. Our Father, Hail Mary for Christian souls.

runes: ᛭ ᛒᛂᛏᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚠᚤᚱᚱᛂ ᛫ ᛔᛂᛏᛅᚱᛋ ᛋᛁᛅᛚ ᚴᛅᚢᛔᛅᚱᚠᛅ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛏᚬ ᛬ ᛋᛁᛅᚢ ᚾᛅᛏᚢᛘ ᛂᚠᛑᛂᚱ ᚾᚤ ᛏᛅ ᚢᛅᚱ ᛬ ᚬ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚴ ᛬ ᛔᚱᛁᛘ ᛬ ᛁ ᛬ ᚠᛁᚢᚱᛏᛅᚾᛑᚬ ᚱᛅᛏᚬ
translit: + betin · fyrre · petars sial kauparfa : han : to : siau natum efder ny ta uar : o : ok : k : prim : i : fiurtando rato
norse: Biðið fyrir "Pétars sál "Kauparfa/"Kauparve. Hann dó sjau náttum eptir ný. Þá var o ok k prím í fjórtándu raðu.
english: Pray for Pétar of Kauparfr/Kauparve's soul. He died seven nights after New [Year]. Then O and K were prime[-staves] in the fourteenth row.

translit: + kirkian : bran : a : beleþes:byrd : lauga:dahe : ta : uar : h : sunnu:tahr : ok : s : prim : i : tretando : raþo
norse: Kirkjan brann á bíletisbyrð laugardegi. Þá var h sunnudagr ok s prím í þrettándu raðu
english: The church burnt on the Saturday "Bearing of the statue" (saint's procession). They H was the Sunday[-stave] and S the prime-stave in the thirteenth row.

norse: "Ingimarr ok "Ólafr þeir svensku menn, þeir gutu þessa klokku ôllu.
english: Ingimarr and Ólafr, these Swedish men, they cast this bell wholly.

norse: ... "Bótulfs móðir af "Vestrhvetjum/"Västerväte ok "Bótheiðr, hans húsfreyja, "Mundvalds systir af "Ringheim/"Ringome. Hverr sem þetta ...
english: ... Bótulfr of Vestrhvetjir/Västerväte's mother and Bótheiðr, his housewife, Mundvaldr of Ringheim/Ringome's sister. Whosoever ... this ...

norse: Hústrú "Gertruð ... borin í "Mylnu/"Mölner, hon lét hôggva þe[nn]a stein yfir sinn bónda.
english: The wife Gertruð ... born in Myln/Mölner, she had this stone cut over her husbandman.
Here rests Olavus.

english: In the name of Jesus ... prayers ...
Brother Jakobr of Isomi/Isome
horn/corn/thorn horn/corn/thorn
Jacobus

translit: + iuan : i : grenium : han : gaf : þisa : krunnu : fyrst : guði : ok : uari : frru : ok : þairi : helhu : kirkiu : senni : sial : til : þarfa : ok : siða
norse: "Jóhan í "Grenjum/"Gräne hann gaf þessa krúnu fyrst "Guði ok várri frú ok þeiri heilagu kirkju sinni sál til þarfa ok síða[n] ...
english: Jóhan in Grenjir/Gräne, he gave this crown first to God and our Lady and their holy church, for his soul's need, and then ...
§A Hail(?). Hail(?) §B Mary §C Mary
Hróðvisl and Farbjôrn and Gunnbjôrn.

norse: "Bótheiðr í "Bellingabó/"Bällings lét þenna stein gera yfir "Ólaf sinn h[úsbónda](?). Í því ári þá var hagal sunnudagr h ok lôgr l prímstafr í sjundu raðu í [t]aflunni. Biðið fyrir "Ólafs sál í "Bellingabo/"Bällings. "Guð gefi sálu þinn[i] ... með ôllu[m] kr[i]stnum sálum.
english: Bótheiðr in Bellingabó/Bällings had this stone made over Ólafr, her husbandman(?). In that year H, Hail, was the Sunday[-stave] and L, Water, the prime-stave in the seventh row in the table. Pray for Ólafr in Bellingabo/Bällings's soul. May God give your soul ... with all Christian souls.

norse: "Sigmundr lét reisa stein eptir brœðr sína ok brú gera eptir "Sigbjôrn, sankta "Mikjáll hjalpi [sál h]ans, ok at "Bótreif ok at "Sigreif ok at "Eibjôrn, fôður þeira allra, ok bjó hann í bý sunnarst. "Geirviðr lagði ormálur, "Næmr/næmr innti ór. "Sigmundr [he]fr slíku unnit kuml. Karlmônnum þat er ... kunn. Hér mun standa steinn at merki, bjartr á bergi, en brú fyrir. "Hróðbjôrn risti rúnar þessar, "Geirl[e]ifr sumar, er gørla kann.
english: Sigmundr had the stone raised in memory of his brothers, and the bridge made in memory of Sigbjôrn - may saint Michael help his soul - and in memory of Bótreifr and in memory of Sigreifr and in memory of Eibjôrn, father of them all, and he lived in the most southern estate. Geirviðr laid the snake-loop(?), Næmr sorted them out. / skilful he sorted them out. Sigmundr has thus produced the monument. For males, it is a known ... Here may the stone stand as a landmark, clearly on the hill, and the bridge before it. Hróðbjôrn carved these runes, Geirleifr some, who well knows how.
(Dedicated) to the horse (?)
ale

english: Pray to God for Nikulás of Klinti/Klints' soul, who lies out here.

english: Lafranz, son of Master Bótviðr, made this church, of Áskelheimr/Eskilhem.

norse: "Véfastr lét [rei]sa s[tei]n þenna eptir "Odda, [f]ô[ð]ur sinn. "Guð hjalpi sálu hans. Þeir môrkuðu rúnar, "Ôlvir ok "Brandr.
english: Véfastr had this stone raised in memory of Oddi, his father. May God help his soul. Ôlvir and Brandr, they marked the runes.

english: §P Guðnjótr Þóru(?)'s son had this stone erected and made the bridge in memory of his brothers Ásbjôrn and in memory of Guðlafr. §Q Guðnjótr Þrór's son had this stone erected and made the bridge in memory of his brothers Ásbjôrn and in memory of Guðlafr.

translit: hrumuntr rit staina þina aftiR hikiulf ÷ brisa sun ÷ in brisi uas lina sun : in lini uas unaR sun : in un ua faks sun in ufak a þuris sun hrumunt hikiulfa sun faþi runaR þisaR : uiR sutum stin þina nur i balas in : krua uas muþiR hikiulf in þa barlaf in þa kuþrun ÷ kiulfiR uarþ um lanti þisu in þa nur i uika þrim bium in þa lanakri in þa fiþrasiu
norse: §A "Hróðmundr rétt[i] stein/steina þenna/þessa eptir "Hé-Gylf[a] "Brísa son. En "Brísi var "Lina sonr. En "Lini var "Unar sonr. En "Unn va[r "Ó]feigs sonr. En "Ófeig[r v]a[r] "Þóris sonr. "Hróðmundr, "Hé-Gylfa sonr, fáði rúnar þessar. Vér sóttum stein þenna norðr í "Balas[te]in. "Gróa var móðir "Hé-Gylf[a]/"Hé-Gylf[is]. En þá "Berglôf/"Bergleif. En þá "Guðrún. §B "Gylfir varð um landi þessu, en þá norðr í vega/"<uika> þrím býjum, en þá "Lønangri, en þá "Feðrasjó.
english: §A Hróðmundr erected this/these stone/s in memory of Hé-Gylfir, Brísi's son. And Brísi was Lini's son. And Lini was Unn's son. And Unn was Ófeigr's son. And Ófeigr was Þórir's son. Hróðmundr, Hé-Gylfir's son, coloured these runes. We sought this stone in the north in Balasteinn. Gróa was Hé-Gylfir's mother. And then Berglôf/Bergleif. And then Guðrún. §B Gylfir acquired this land and then three estates in a northerly direction / <uika> in the north, and then Lønangr and then Feðrasjór.

runes: ᚼᚱᚢᛘᚢᚾᛏᚱ ᚼᛁᚴᛁᚢᛚᚠᛁᛋ ᛋᚢᚾ ᚱᛁᛏᛁ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚼᛁᚴᛁᚢ ᚠᛅ ᛒᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚼᚱᚢᛘᚢᚾ ᛁᚾ ᚦᛅ ᚦᚢᚱᛘᚢᚾᛏ ᛁᚾ ᚦᛅ ᛋᚾᚱᛅᚱᛁᛦ ᛁ ᚦᛅ ᚢᚾ
translit: hrumuntr hikiulfis sun riti stain þina aftiR hikiu fa brisa sun : hrumun in þa þurmunt in þa snrariR i þa un
norse: "Hróðmundr "Hé-Gylfis sonr rétti stein þenna eptir "Hé-Gy[l]fa "Brísa son. "Hróðmun[dr], en þá "Þormundr, en þá "Snerrir, e[n] þá "Unn.
english: Hróðmundr, Hé-Gylfir's son, erected this stone in memory of Hé-Gylfir, Brísi's son. Hróðmundr, and then Þormundr, and then Snerrir, and then Unn.

[me]rki þetta. §Q Eptir "Ketilbjôrn ok "Ônund, son hans, ok "Seyvarar(?). "Ánn(?), "Ásviðr ok "Ótryggr ok "Sigbjôrn, þeir létu rétta stein. "Guð hjalpi ô[nd] ... [me]rki þetta.

english: §PA One ox and two ounces of silver (in fine) to the staff for the restoration of a sanctuary in a valid state for the first time; two oxen and four ounces of silver (in fine) for the second time; but for the third time four oxen and eight ounces of silver (in fine); and all property in suspension, if he doesn’t make right. §B That, the people are entitled to demand, according to the law of the people, that was decreed and ratified before. But they made themselves this "ring", Anund from Tåsta and Ofeg from Hjortsta. translit: simeon : risti : runar þa : æs : þeir : foru : bali : ouk : kolbiorn : m naþ : þorbini : sendi:mani
norse: "Simeon risti rúnar, þá er þeir fóru, "Balli ok "Kolbjôrn. Mun náð "Þorbirni sendimanni.
english: Simeon carved runes when Balli and Kolbjôrn travelled (out). (They) should have reached Þorbjôrn the Messenger.

translit: ek hæitk iesus naþarenum ek haitit esus naþarenum ek þolde harþan dauþ to:mas
norse: §AP Ek heiti "Jésús "Nazarenus §AQ Ek heiti "Jésús "Nazarenus §B Ek þolða harðan dauð. §C "Thomás.
english: §AP I am called Jesus of Nazareth. §AQ I am called Jesus of Nazareth. §B I suffered the hard death. §C Thomás.

translit: + sagta maria : a mik ouk hnar sun kriister øuk alir hlk u k uþrs ouk alir bostolar hans
norse: §A Sankta "María á mik ok hennar sonr "Kristr §B ok allir helgu "Guðs ok allir postolar hans.
english: §A Saint Mary and Christ her son own me, §B and all of God's saints and all of His apostles.

translit: þorolfr : gærþi : kirku þesa ÷: askrimr ÷ hakon ÷ ælikr ÷ pal æinriþi ÷ siønti ÷ þorolfr þorer ÷ ræist olafr
english: §A Þórolfr made this church. Ásgrímr, Hákon, Erlingr, Páll, Eindriði, Sjaundi, Þórulfr. §B Þórir carved. §C Ólafr.

english: §A ... and (for) Atli for pardon of §B his sins and §A for himself and for all Christian folk.

translit: þorolfr : kærþi : kirkiu þesa : en : kæræ:stæin : uar filakr : ok þæir : kunar : uiþar : æyintr : æirikkr : kunar : nu hæfi ek ristit : alra alfr uar ok
norse: "Þórulfr gerði kirkju þessa, en "Geirsteinn var félagi ok þeir "Gunnarr, "Víðarr, "Eyvindr, "Eiríkr, "Gunnarr. Nú hefi ek ristit allra. "Alfr var ok.
english: Þórulfr made this church and Geirsteinn was (his) partner and Gunnarr, Víðarr, Eyvindr, Eiríkr, Gunnarr: now I have carved all. Alfr was also.

runes: ᚦᛅᚱ ᛂᚱ ᛅᛚᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛂᛘ ᚢᚾᛁᚱ ᛬ ᛅᛁᚴᛁ ᛂᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛚᛁᚼᛏ ᛋᛂᛘ ᛘᚢᚾᛁᚱ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚱᛅ ᛏ ᚱᚢᛅᚱ ᛭
translit: þar er alr : sem unir : æiki er : sliht sem munir : þorþr : ræ t ruar +
norse: Þar er allr sem unir, eigi er slíkt sem munir. "Þórðr re[is]t rúnar.
english: One feels complete where one feels satisfaction; nothing is comparable to desire. Þórðr carved runes.
Eyvindr has this ...
Víðarr. Hail [Mary], (Our) Father(?)

runes: ᛭ ᚦᛁᛋᛋᛅ ᛬ ᚴᛚᚬᚴᚬ ᛬ ᛚᛂᛏᚬ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᚤᛔᛅ ᛅᛚᚢᛂᚱ ᛬ ᛔᚱᛂᛋᛏᚱ ᛬ ᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚵᛑᛅᛚᛂ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚦᚱᛑᚱ ᛬ ᛒᚬᚾᛑᛂ ᛬ ᛅ ᛅᚢᚴᚢᛘ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᚤᛔᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛏᚬᚢᛂ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᚱ᛬ᛋᚬᚾ
translit: + þissa ÷ kloko ÷ leto ÷ stæypæ aluer ÷ prestr ÷ i ÷ sigdale ÷ ok ÷ þrdr ÷ bonde ÷ a aukum ÷ stæypti ÷ toue ÷ þorr÷son
norse: Þessa klokku létu steypa "Ôlvir prestr í "Sigdali ok "Þórðr bóndi á "[H]augum, steypti "Tófi "Þórðarsonr.
english: Ôlvir, priest of Sigdalr and Þórðr, the husbandman of Haugar, had this bell cast. Tófi Þórðr's son cast (it).

runes: ᛋᛅᛁᛚᚵᛅᚱᚦᚱ ᚼᚤᛁᛚᛁᚱ ᚼᛂᚱ ᚵᚢᚦ ᚵᛅᛏᛁᛂ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛅᛋᛚᛅᚴᚱ ᛘᛅᚱᚴᛅᚦᛁ ᛘᛁᚴ
translit: sailgærþr hyilir her guþ gætie þina aslakr markaþi mik
norse: "Salgerðr hvílir hér. "Guð gæti þín-na. "Áslakr markaði mik.
english: Salgerðr rests here. God protect you. Áslakr marked me.
Geirmundr made me.

runes: ᛅᛋᛚᛅᚴᛅᚱ ᛬ ᚵᛂᚱᚦᛂ ᛘᛁᚴ ᛬ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᛬ ᛂᚴ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛏ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚱᛅᚦ᛬ᚾᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅ᛫ᚢᛂ ᛬ ᚢᛂᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚴᛁ
translit: aslacar : gerþe mik : runar : ek · rist : auk · raþ:na : sta·ue : uer · sici
norse: §A "Áslakr gerði mik. Rúnar ek ríst ok ráðna stafi. ... §B ...
english: §A Áslakr made me. Runes I carve and interpreted (interpretable?) staves ... §B ...
Þorgautr Dandelion made me.
Grant to me all good.
Hallvarðr owns me.
Jesus
Hail Mary, (full of) grace
through Jesus.
Sigríðr owns.
§A ... §B Ubbi made.

runes: ᛭ ᚾᛁᚴᚢᛚᛅᛋ ᛅᛏᛚᛅᛋᚢᚾ ᚴᛂᚱᚦᛂ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᛅ ᛘᚱᚴᚬᛘ ᚼᛅᛚ
translit: + nikulas atlasun kerþe runar a mrkom hal
english: Nikulás Atli's son made runes on many rock-slabs.

english: §P Hávarðr Faithful coloured. §Q Hávarðr ... coloured.

runes: ᛭ ᛅᚢᛂ ᛬ ᛘᛅᚱᛁᛅ ᛬ ᚵᚱᛅᚴᛁᛅ ᛬ ᛔᛚᛂᚾᛅ ᛬ ᛑᚬᛘᛁᚾᚢᛋ ᛬ ᛏᛂᚴᚢᛘ ᛬ ᛒᛂᚾᛂᛑᛁᚴᛏᛅ ᛬ ᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛘᚢᛚᛁᛂᚱᛁᛒᚢᛋ ᛬ ᛅᚦ ᛬ ᛒ ᛬ ᚠ ᛬ ᚢ ᛬ ᛏᚢᛁ ᛬
translit: + aue : maria : gracia : plena : dominus : tecum : benedicta : tu : in : mulieribus : æþ : b : f : u : tui :
norse: Ave "Maria gratia plena. Dominus tecum, benedicta tu in mulieribus, et b[enedictus] f[ructus] v[entris] tui. {A[men]}.
english: Hail Mary, full of grace. The Lord is with Thee: blessed art Thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb. {Amen}.

runes: ᛭ ᛑᛂᚼᛏᛂᚱᛅ ᛑᚬᛘᛁᚾᛁ ᚠᛂᚴᚴ ᚢᛁᚱᛏᚢᛏᛂᛘ ᛑᛂᚼᛏᛂᚱᛅ ᛑᚬᛘᛁᚾᛁ ᛂᚼᛚᛅᚢᛁᛏ ᛘᛂ ᛑᛂᚼᛏᛂᚱᛅ
translit: + dehtera domini feck uirtutem dehtera domini ehlauit me dehtera
norse: Dextera Domini fecit virtutem, dextera Domini exaltavit me, dextera.
english: The right hand of the Lord did mighty work, the right hand of the Lord raised me up, the right hand
... nurse! ...
Kári Neriðr's son carved me.

runes: ᚱᛅᚾᚾᛅᚱ ᛬ ᛒᛁᛋᚴᚬᛔ ᛬ ᚢᛁᚵᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚴᛁᚱ᛬ᚴᛁᚢ ᛬ ᚦᛂᛋᛋᛅ ᛬ ᚦᛅ ᛬ ᚠᚤᚵᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚼᚬᚾᚬᛘ ᛬ ᚠᚤᛚᚵᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚦᛅ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚴᛅᛔᛅᛚᛅᛁᚾ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᛅᛁᚾᛅᚱ ᛬ ᚾᛅᚠᚱ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᚦᚱᚬᚾᛏᚱ ᛬ ᛘᚬᚴᚱ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚱᛅᚢᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᚦᚬᚾᛏᚱ ᛬ ᚴᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏ ᛬ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᛬ ᚦᛂᛋᛅᚱ
translit: rannar : biskop : uigþi : kir:kiu : þessa : þa : fygþi : honom : fylgþi : þa : þorþr : kapalæin ok : æinar : nafr : ok þrontr : mokr : ok : þorstæin : rauþi : ok þontr : kin : ok han : ræist : runar : þesar
norse: "Ragnarr biskup vígði kirkju þessa. Þá fýlgði honum, fylgði þá "Þórðr kapaleinn ok "Einarr "Nafarr ok "Þróndr munkr ok "Þorsteinn "Rauði ok "Þróndr "Kinn, ok hann reist rúnar þessar.
english: Bishop Ragnarr dedicated this church. He was then assisted, then assisted by Þórðr the Chaplain and Einarr Nave-borer/Auger and Þróndr the monk and Þorsteinn Red and Þróndr Chin, and he carved these runes.

runes: ᛂᛏᛅ ᛬ ᛂᚱ ᛬ ᚵᚢᚦᛅᛋ ᛬ ᚼᚢᛋ ᛫ ᛅᚴ ᛫ ᚵᚢᚦ ᛫ ᛒᛚᛅᛋᛁ ᛫ ᚦᛅᚾ ᛫ ᛂᚱ ᛫ ᚵᛂᚱᛅ ᛫ ᛚᛂᛏ ᛫ ᛅᚴ ᛫ ᛋᚢᛅ ᛫ ᚼᚢᛅᚾ ᛫ ᚦᛅᚾ ᛫ ᛋᚬᛘ ᛫ ᚢᛔ ᛫ ᚼᛅᛚᛏᛅᚱ
translit: eta : er : guþas : hus · æk · guþ · blæsi · þan · er · gera · let · æk · sua · huæn · þan · som · up · hæltar
norse: [Þ]etta er "Guðs hús, ok "Guð blezi þann er gera lét, ok svá hvern þann sem upp heldr.
english: This is God's house and may God bless he who had (it) made and whosoever maintains (it).
§A <fuþorkhniastblmyøæc> §B ... <fuþoork> ...
Áslakr the priest wrote these runes.

runes: ᚦᚬᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛒᛂᚾᚵᛅᛁᚱ ᚱᛅᛁᛏ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᚦᛂᛋᛋᛅᚱ ᛋᚢᛏᛅᚼ ᚦᛅᚾ ᛂᚱ ᚾᛂᛋᚱ ᚾᛂᛏ ᛁᚬᛚᚬᛘ
translit: þostæin bengæir ræit runar þessar sutah þan er nesr net iolom
norse: "Þorsteinn "Bengeirr reit rúnar þessar sunnudag þann, er næstr ... jólum.
english: Þorsteinn Sore-spear wrote these runes on the Sunday which is closest ... Christmas.
Ólafr ...

runes: ᛅᚦᚱ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᚦᛂᛋᛅᚱ ᛂᚱ ᚼᛅᛁᛏᛁᚱ ᚴᛅᛏᛁᛚ ᛋᚢᛅᛁᛋᚢᚾ ᛁ ᛅᛒᚤ ᛭ ᚦᚬᚱᛘᚬᚦᚱ ᚼᛁᛚᛏ ᛘᛂᚱ ᛘᛂᚦᛅᚾ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛘᛅᛁᚱᚴᛏᛁ ᛘᛁᚴ ᛫ ᚴᛅᛏᛁᛚ ᛋᛘᛁᚦᚱ
translit: aþr ræist runar þesar er hæitir kætil suæisun i aby + þormoþr hilt mer meþan han mæirkti mik · kætil smiþr
norse: [Sá(?) m]aðr reist rúnar þessar er heitir "Ketill "Sveinssonr í "Ábý. "Þormóðr helt mér, meðan hann merkti mik. "Ketill "Smiðr.
english: That man carved these runes who is called Ketill Sveinn's son of Ábýr. Þormóðr held me while he marked me. Ketill the smith.
Rock-slab be as witness!
§A giants(') ... §B Lord(?)

runes: ᛭ ᚬᚴᛘᚬᛚᛂ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛚ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᚦᛂᛋᛅᚱ ᚢᚴ ᛒᛁᚦᚱ ᚦᚯᚱᛋ ᛅᛚᛘᛅᚴᛅᚾ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛏᛅᚴᛂ ᛬ ᚢᛁᚦᚱ ᛋ ᛚ ᚴᛅᛘᛅᛋ ᛬ ᛂᚱ ᚦᛂᛋᛋᛂ ᛋᛚᛅᛁᚾ ᛏᛁᚴᚱ ᛁᛒᛁᚱ ᛭
translit: + okmole : ræisl runar þesar uk biþr þørs almakan kuþ ÷ at han take ÷ uiþr s l kamas : er þesse slæin tikr ibir +
norse: "Ôgmundr reist rúnar þessar,  ok biðr þess almátkan "Guð, at hann taki viðr s[á]l "Gamals, er þessi steinn liggr yfir.
english: Ôgmundr carved these runes, and prays to the almighty God that he receive the soul of Gamall, whom this stone lies over.
Unnulfr made this bell.

runes: ᛅ ᚱ ᛋ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛋᛂ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᚦᛂᛋᛅᚱ ᚢᛘ ᛘᛂᛅᚱᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚦᛂᛏᛅ ᛁᛏ ᚠᚤᛋᛏᛅ ᛔᚢᚱᚦᛅᚱᛁᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛘᚢᚦ
translit: a r s ÷ ræse runar þesar um meærþi ÷ þeta it fysta purþarian ÷ muþ
norse: "A[nd]r[é]s(?) reist rúnar þessar ok gerði þetta it fyrsta hurðarjarn. "Guð(?)/"Guði(?) ...
english: Andrés(?) carved these runes and made this, the first door-hinge. God (be praised?) ...

runes: ᛭ ᚦᚬᚱᚬᛚᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛏ ᛭ ᛋᛅ ᛋᚴᛅᛚ ᛭ ᚱᛅᚦᛅ ᛭ ᚱᚢ ᚱ ᚦᚬᚱᚬᛚᚱ ᛋᛏᚬᚱᚬᛚᛋ
translit: × þorolr × rit × sa skal × raþa × ru r þorolr storols
english: §A Þórulfr wrote. He shall interpret (the) runes ... §B Þórulfr Stórulfssonr
Here rests Pétr the priest.

english: Arngeirr's sons raised this rock-slab in memory of Þjóðulfr, (their) brother. Guðmundr carved these runes, he and Ôndóttr from Mœri(?).
... Ánn(?)/Ónn(?), Grípr, Gunnarr.
Runes ...

english: Vésteinn carved these runes. Hail both he who carved, and he who interprets (the runes).

norse: "Sigurðr "Jarlssonr reist rúnar þessar laugardaginn eptir "Bótulfsmessu, er hann flýði hingat ok vildi eigi ganga til sættar við "Sverri fôðurbana sinn ok brœðra.
english: Sigurðr Jarl's son carved these runes on the Saturday after Bótulfr's-mass when he fled here and did not want to undergo reconciliation with Sverrir, the slayer of his father and brothers.

translit: h lu rþr · krenske · ræist uinar þesr · sæl er · sa er suiki · fyla · sorh · reikar · tohe · græitis · sot · at · kæte · geltr æiþar · þæs · altri · era · fenbrauhþum · flahþa · falner · niþr · meþ · aulu · haukar · balts · auk · halta · huhstriþi · byr·
norse: ... "H[a]llv[a]rðr "Grenski reist rúnar þessar. Sæll er, sá er svíki, fýla, sorg á reikar torgi "Grettis sótt at gæti, geldr eiðar þess aldri. Er-a feiknbrôgðum flagða fallnir niðr með ôllu haukar "Baldrs, ok halda hugstríði byr[skíða].
english: ... Hallvarðr from Grenland (lower Telemark) carved these runes. Never is he fortunate, the brute who betrays: (he can) expect to get sorrow on the hair-part's turf (ie on his head); (he will) pay for this (broken) oath. The breeze-blown skis ( = ships) of Baldr's hawks ( = the warriors) (ie the sea-warriors) are not all felled through the baleful deeds of ogresses, and (they) hold the memory of battle.

english: Haki Bjôrn's son owns me, Sveinn Ásmundr's son hammered me, Ásulfr carved and read me on the first Wednesday after Ólafr's-vigil in the sixth year of the reign of our worthy Sire Magnús, King of Norway.

May God help Magnhildr's soul.

May God help (his) spirit ...
Gunnhildr made the spindle-whorl.

english: Eyvindr, godson of Ólafr the Slippery/Crooked/Holy made this church on his allodial land.

english: Eyvindr raised this stone in memory of Gunnhvatr/Gunnvaldr, his son.
(This) divides here the (outlying-)forests.

english: Rannveig raised the stone in memory of Ôgmundr Hreppir's son, her husband. Skógr struck (the runes).
Gunnarr Bjôrn's(?) son lies here.

norse: §A "Petrus, "Paulus, "Andreas, "Marcus, "Maria, "Matthæus, "Lucas, "Johannes, Tetragrammaton, Agla, "Agios, <annail>, "Messias, "Jesus, "Kristus, "Gu[ð]. §B "María s[æl] m[ær] helga. "Jésús "Kristus. Tetr[agrammaton]. "Hákon.
english: §A Peter, Paul, Andrew, Mark, Mary, Matthew, Luke, John, Tetragrammaton, 'agla' (= Thou art strong in eternity, Lord), holy, Emmanuel?/Adonai? (Lord), Messiah, Jesus Christ, God. §B Fortunate Mary, the holy maiden. Jesus Christ. Tetragrammaton. Hákon.
... raised this stone
Ragni(?) the priest(?).
Rannveig.

norse: "[G]uð signi þann mann er gerði, ok þann er gera lét, þat er "Erlingr "Lo[ptssonr](?).
english: God bless the man who made (me) and he who had (me) made: that is Erlingr Loptr's(?) son.
Long may (they) live, defend!(?)
... raised these stones in memory of ...

english: §A Gautr raised this stone §B in memory of Steinarr, his brother. And Ulfríkr §A the Sorrow-stricken made.
Bjôrn ... his brother.

english: §A Þórir Harðr's son raised this stone in memory of his wife Ásgerðr, daughter of Gunnarr §B (the) brother of Helgi of Kleppr.
Heðinn ... Bôðvarr ...

norse: Ártíð er "Ingibjargar "Káradóttur þrim nóttum eptir krossmessu um várit. Hverr sá maðr rúnar þessar sér, þá sy[ng]i Pater no[s]ter fyrir sál hennar. Hjalpi "Guð þeim er svá gerir.
english: Ingibjôrg Kári's daughter's anniversary-of-death is three nights after Cross-mass in spring. Whoever the man who sees these runes may be, may he sing Our Father for her soul. May God help him who does thus.

runes: ᚼᛅᛁᛚᚴᛁ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᚬᚾ ᛬ ᛅᚠᛏ ᚴᛅᛁᛏᛁᛚ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ

english: Helgi raised this stone in memory of his brother Ketill.

Arnbjôrn's anniversary-of-death.

english: Þorbjôrn Skald raised this stone in memory of <soi->þórir, his son, who fell in Denmark.

english: The day of the anniversary-of-death of Bjôrn Ulfgeirr's son is two nights before Mary's [mass]. Steinn ...

english: Skarði raised this stone in memory of Bjalfi, his son, a very good man.

english: Þormóðr raised this stone in memory of Þróndr, his son.

norse: [Ô]lhúsmenn reistu stein þenna eptir "Skarða, en þeir drukku [e]rfi hans
english: The drinking-companions raised this stone in memory of Skarði when they drank his funeral-feast.

§A Eindriði §B made §C the vessel well.
Eyjulfr carved runes.

english: Ketill raised this stone in memory of Jórunn, his wife, Úþyrmir's(?) daughter.

english: <alf---ir> the priest raised this stone in memory of his lord Erlingr ... when he fought with Óleifr.

runes: ᛚᚢᛅᚱᚴ ᛬ ᛂᚱ ᛬ ᛅᛁᚾᛂ ᛬ ᚾᚬᛏ ᛬᛬ ᛅᚠᛏᛂᚱ ᛬ ᚼᚱᛅ ᛬ ᛘᛅᛋᚬ᛬ᛏᛅᚼ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚢᛋᛂ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏ ᛬

norse: [Ártíð "Ha]llvarðs er eini nótt eptir [Allra heila]gra messudag. "Brúsi reist.

Símun the priest had (me) struck(?) ... mass.

norse: §A "Hafgrími, félag sínum, sendir "Þórir "Fagr kveðju "Guðs ok sína, sannan félagskap ok vináttu. Mart skortir §B mik, félagi! Ekki er mungátit, eingi fiskarnir. Vil ek at þú vitir, en eigi kref §C þú. Bið bóndann koma suðr til vár ok sjá hvat oss líðr. Eggja hann til, en kref þú einskis hluta mér, ok eigi lát þú §D "Þorstein "Lang vita. Send mér hanzka nôkkura. Ef "Sigríðr þarf nôkurs, þá bjóð henni. Heit þú mér ekki vetta hýð válaði.
english: §A Þórir the Fair sends to Hafgrímr his partner his own and God's greeting, and true partnership and friendship. I am lacking much, §B partner; there is no beer, nor fish. I want you to know this, and not make demands. §C Order the husbandman to come south to us and see how we are suffering. Urge him to it, and don't make demands for more lots from me; and do not let §D Þorsteinn Long know. Send me some gloves. If Sigríðr is in need of anything, then offer her. Promise that you will not beat me (at all) for my poverty!

english: Eybjôrn raised this stone in memory of Skerðir. He died in the retinue in England.

english: Grjótgarðr (and) Einriði, the sons made (the stone) in memory of (their) able father. Guðvér was in the west; divided (up) payment in England; manfully attacked townships in Saxony.

english: Vénjótr raised the stone in memory of Guðmundr, his son, a good valiant man.

english: Vésteinn, Agmundr (and) Guðvér, they raised the stone in memory of Báulfr, their father, a Þegn of strength. He was with the Greeks; then died with them.

english: Ingifastr had the stone cut in memory of Sigviðr, his father. He fell in Holmgarðr, the ship's leader with the seamen.

norse: §A "Myskja ok "Manni/"Máni létu reisa kuml þessi at bróður sinn "Hróðgeir ok fôður sinn "Holmstein. §B Hann hafði vestarla um verit lengi, dóu austarla með "Ingvari.
english: §A Myskja and Manni/Máni had these monuments raised in memory of their brother Hróðgeirr and their father Holmsteinn. §B He had long been in the west; died in the east with Ingvarr.

norse: "Ólafr(?)/"Óblauðr(?)/"Upphlaupr(?) lét gera kuml, líkhús/líknhús ok brú at son sinn "Bjôrn, var drepinn á "Gotlandi. Þý lét fjôr sitt, flýðu gengir, þeir ... vildu ekki halda. "Guð hjalpi anda hans.
english: Ólafr(?)/Óblauðr(?)/Upphlaupr(?) had the monument and sarcophagus/hospice and bridge made in memory of his son Bjôrn, (who) was killed on Gotland. Because his followers fled, he lost his life; they ... would not hold. May God help his spirit.

norse: "Ámundi(?) reisti stein þenna eptir son sinn "Rúnulf/"Unnulf ok "Hring(?), bróður sinn. Varð úti drepinn í "Kalmarna sundum, fóru af "Skáney. "Áskell/"Ásgeirr risti rúnar þessar.
english: Ámundi(?) raised this stone in memory of his son Rúnulfr/Unnulfr, and Hringr(?), his brother. (He) was killed out in the Kalmarnir sound, (as they) travelled from Scania. Áskell/Ásgeirr carved these runes.
... his/her good husbandman.

english: Ulfr(?) raised this stone in memory of his brother Ósníkinn. He perished in the east with Ingvarr; (he was) Holmsteinn's seaman.

Auðulfr made the church.

norse: §A "Ketill ok "Bjôrn þeir reistu stein þenna at "Þorstein, fôður sinn, "Ônundr at bróður sinn ok húskarlar eptir(?) jafna, "Ketiley at bónda sinn. Brœðr váru þeir beztra manna, á landi ok í liði úti, heldu sína húskarla ve[l]. §B Hann fell í orrostu austr í "Gôrðum, liðs forungi, landmanna beztr.
english: §A Ketill and Bjôrn, they raised this stone in memory of Þorsteinn, their father; Ônundr in memory of his brother and the housecarls in memory of the just(?) (and) Ketiley in memory of her husbandman. These brothers were the best of men in the land and abroad in the retinue, held their housecarls well. §B He fell in battle in the east in Garðar (Russia), commander of the retinue, the best of landholders.

norse: "[Hrœ]r[í]kr gerði kuml þetta eptir "Ásmund, son sinn. Hann er grafinn á "Go[tlandi]/ku[mli] hreyr <uart>/<fart> at "Hrœríks son.
english: Hrœríkr made this monument in memory of Ásmundr, his son. He is buried in Gotland / the monument(?) ... cairn(?) in memory of Hrœríkr's son.

norse: "Vígleikr ok "Kjúli/"Gylli ok "Helgi ok "Ígulfastr, þeir reistu stein eptir "Þorbjôrn.
english: Vígleikr and Kjúli/Gylli and Helgi and Ígulfastr, they raised the stone in memory of Þorbjôrn.

translit: þurþr : auk : tuki + raistu + stain + þansi + aftiR + bysiu ++ faþur sin ¤ han + uarþ tauþr : o kniri :
norse: "Þórðr ok "Tóki reistu stein þenna eptir "Bysju, fôður sinn. Hann varð dauðr á knerri.
english: Þórðr and Tóki raised this stone in memory of Bysja, their father. He died on the cargo-ship.

norse: "Þorbjôrn ok "Freylaug létu rétta stein eptir "Eynd, son sinn.
english: Þorbjôrn and Freylaug had the stone erected in memory of Eyndr, their son.

english: Guðfastr (and) Sæulfr raised the stone in memory of Holmsteinn, their brother.

runes: ᚠᛅᚱᛅᚢᚴᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛁᚾᛅᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᚢᛚᛅᛁᚠ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᚴᛅᛁᛦᚢᚾᛁ

norse: "Freygeirr reisti stein þenna at "Óleif, fôður sinn. Hann átti "Geirunni.
english: Freygeirr raised this stone in memory of Óleifr, his father. He owned (ie was married to) Geirunn.

runes: ᛚᛅᚠᛦ ᛫ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᚦᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚦᛅᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛋᚢᛚᚠᚢ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚾ ᚢᛅᚱᚦ ᛬ ᚢᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛫ ᛏᛅᚢᚦᚱ

norse: "Ólafr reisti stein þenna eptir "Sylfu/"Solfu, son sinn. Hann varð vestr dauðr.
english: Ólafr raised this stone in memory of Sylfa/Solfa, his son. He died in the west.

runes: ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛅᚤᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚾᛅᛏᚠᛅᚱᛁ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᚠᛁᚾᚢᛁᚦ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚢᛚᛁᚠ ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᚴᛁᛚ ᛒᚢᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚢᛅᚱᚢ ᛫ ᛅᛚᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚢᛁᚴᛁᚴᛋ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾᛁᛦ ᛚᛅᛏᛒᚢᚱᚾᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛘᛅᚾ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾᚴᛁᛚ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛏ ᛫ ᚱᚢᚾᛅᛦ
translit: þurstain : auk : aystain : auk : natfari : raistu : stain : at : finuiþ : auk : ulif : þurkil buruþr sin uaru · aliR · uikiks · suniR latburniR · man · litu · rita · stain stainkil · rist · runaR
norse: §A "Þorsteinn ok "Eysteinn ok "Náttfari reistu stein at "Finnvið ok "Óleif, "Þorkel, brœðr sína. Váru allir "Víkings synir, landbornir menn, létu rétta stein. §B "Steinkell reist rúnar.
english: §A Þorsteinn and Eysteinn and Náttfari raised the stone in memory of Finnviðr and Óleifr (and) Þorkell, their brothers. (They) were all Víkingr's sons, men born to land(ed property), (who) had the stone erected. §B Steinkell carved the runes.

runes: ᚦᚬᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛚᛁ ᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛂᚾᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚴ ᛬ ᛋᛁᛅᛚᚠᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛂᚠᚾᛁ ᛬ ᚢᛅᛦ ᛏᛁᛚ ᛬ ᛂᚾᚴᛚᛅᚾᛋ ᛬ ᚢᚴᚱ ᛬ ᛏᚱᛂᚾᚴᚱ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚱᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚢᛅᚱᚦ ᛬ ᚦᛅ ᛫ ᚼᛅᛁᛘᛅ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚱᛘᛁ ᛏᛅᚢᚦᚱ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛬ ᛋᛁᛅᛚᚢ ᛬ ᚦᛅᛁᛘᛅ ᛒᚱᚢᚾᛁ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛋᛚᚬᚦᛁ ᛬ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᚢ ᛋᛏᛅᚾ ᚦᛂᚾᛅ
translit: þorstain li sa : stain : þena : sik : sialfan : auk : sun : sin : hefni : uaR til : enklans : ukr : trenkr : farin : uarþ : þa · haima : at : harmi tauþr kuþ hialbi : sialu : þaima bruni : auk : sloþi : þaiR u stan þena
norse: "Þorsteinn lé[t rei]sa stein þenna [eptir] sik sjalfan ok son sinn "Hefni. Var til "Englands ungr drengr farinn, varð þá heima at harmi dauðr. "Guð hjalpi sálu þeira. "Brúni ok "Slóði þeir [rist]u stein þenna.
english: Þorsteinn had this stone raised in memory of himself and his son Hefnir. The young valiant man travelled to England; then died grievously at home. May God help their souls. Brúni and Slóði, they carved this stone.

translit: iak · uait : hastain : þa : hulmstain : bryþr · menr : rynasta : a : miþkarþi : setu : stain : auk : stafa : marga eftiR · fraystain · faþur · sin ·
norse: Ek veit "Hástein þá "Holmstein brœðr menn rýnasta á "Miðgarði, settu stein ok stafa marga eptir "Freystein, fôður sinn.
english: I know Hásteinn and Holmsteinn, the most rune-skilled brothers in Middle Earth, placed many a stone and staff in memory of Freysteinn, their father.

runes: ᛒᛅᛚᛁ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚢᚠᛅᛁᚴᛦ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᚦᚢ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛬ ᛋᚢᛅᚱᛏᚼᛅᚠᚦᛅ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ

norse: "Balli ok "Ófeigr reistu stein at "Svarthôfða, bróður sinn.
english: Balli and Ófeigr raised the stone in memory of Svarthôfði, their brother.

runes: ᛚᛁᚠᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚠᚱᛅᚢᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢ ᚢᚾᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛋᚢᛅᚱᛏᚼᛅᚢᚠᚦᛅ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚠᛅᚦ
translit: lifstain · fraubiarn · au uniR : suarthaufþa : eftiR : sin faþ
english: Hlífsteinn and Freybjôrn and ... Svarthôfði's sons in memory of their father.

english: Sæulfr ... his father ...
... his father/brother, the husbandman ...

translit: auþa : auk : ika · auk · erintis · þriþi · hafa · muþk þ um · karua · stain ra itiR · suain · faþur : sin · auk · at kuþfast · bruþr · sin · han uaR : sun : auþuR
norse: "Auða ok "Inga ok "Erindís, þriði, hafa mœðg[ur] [í]ð um gera/gôrva stein re[isa](?) eptir "Svein, fôður sinn, ok at "Guðfast, bróður sinn. Hann var sonr "Auðu.
english: Auða and Inga and Erindís as the third, the mother and daughters have (achieved) the feat of making and raising(?) the stone in memory of Sveinn, their father, and in memory of Guðfastr, their brother. He was Auða's son.

runes: ᚦᚬᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛁᛚᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛂᛏᚱ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛅᛚᚢᛁ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛋᛁᛘᛁᚦᚱ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᛋᛂᚾ ᛒᚬᚱᚬᚦᚢᚱ

norse: "Þorsteinn lét þenna rétta stein, hæfila(?) stendr eptir "Þorbjôrn, "Sôlvi ok "Smiðr at sinn bróður.
english: Þorsteinn had this stone erected, (and) Salvi and Smiðr in memory of their brother: it competently(?) stands in memory of Þorbjôrn.

runes: ᚴᚢᚾᛁ ᛬ ᚱᛅᛋᛏᛁ ᛋᛏᛅᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛅᚾᛋᛁ ᛬ ᛅ ᚱᛅᚵᚾᛅ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛅᚾ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚦᛅᚾ ᛬ ᛁ ᚢᛅᚴ ᛬ ᚢᛅᚦ ᛬ ᛏᛅᚦᛦ ᚢᛅᛋᛏᚱ

norse: "Gunni reisti stein þenna at "Ragna, son sinn góðan, í veg varð dauðr vestr.
english: Gunni raised this stone in memory of Ragni, his good son; (he) died on the western route.

translit: : ualr raisti : stain : iftiR · mana auk saikiR · bruþur : sin : auk · bruþ × sin · :ualr raisti : stain : iftiR · mana auk saikiR · bruþur : sin : auk · bruþ × sin ·
norse: §P "Valr reisti stein eptir "Manna/"Mána ... ... ok "Sægeir, bróður sinn ok bróður sinn. §Q "...valdr reisti stein eptir "Manna/"Mána ... ... ok "Sægeir, bróður sinn ok bróður sinn.
english: Valr/...-valdr raised the stone in memory of Manni/Máni ... and (in memory of) Sægeirr, his brother and his brother.

runes: ᛬ ᚴᚢᚠᛁ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚦᚢᚱᚴᛁᛋᛚ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚢᛁᚴᛁᛚᛦ ᛫ ᛁᚾᚴᚢᛅᛚᚱ ᛬ ᚦᛂᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛬ ᛚᛅᚴᚦᚢ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚦᛁᚾᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛏᚱ ᛬ ᛅᛏᛁᛚ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚾ ᚢᛅᛦ ᛫ ᛘᛁᚦᛅ ᛫ ᛒᛂᛋᛏᚱ
translit: : kufi : auk : þurkisl : auk : uikilR · inkualr : þeiR : bruþr : lakþu : stain · þinsa : eftr : atil : faþur · sin : han uaR · miþa · bestr
norse: "Gufi ok "Þorgísl ok "Véketill(?) [ok] "Ingivaldr þeir brœðr lôgðu stein þenna eptir "Etil, fôður sinn. Hann var manna beztr.
english: Gufi and Þorgísl and Véketill(?) and Ingivaldr, these brothers laid this stone in memory of Etill, their father. He was the best of men.

english: Gjafaldr and Borgfastr and Andvéttr and Þjalfi, they had the stone erected in memory of Jón, their kinsman. Ingulfr cut the stone. Þjalfi cut the stone.

... Guðfastr cut(?) ... father ...

... the stones raised in memory of his/Seinn.
Kagr(?)/Gagr(?) and Hugi carved the runes ...
... had ... erected ...

runes: ᚢᚾᛅᚱ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛋᚢᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛅᛏ ᛭ ᛏᚬᚾᚢ ᛭ ᛘᚬᚦᚢᚱ

runes: ᚱᚢᚾᚢᛁᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚤᚠᛏᛦ ᛫ ᛋᚢᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛁᚾ ᚴᛚᛋ ᛁ ᛁᚢᚠᚢᚱ ᛫ ᚬᚴ ᛫ ᚠᚢᚴᛋ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᚤᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚴᛅᚱᛅ

english: Óðalfríðr/Óðalfreðr raised these stones in memory of Styrr, her/his father. May God help their spirits. Brandr cut the runes.

norse: "Arta(?) lét hôggva stein at fôður sinn "Nefgeir ok "Heðinfast at bónda sinn ok "Eysteinn at bróður sinn.
english: Arta(?) had the stone cut in memory of his father Nefgeirr; and Heðinfast in memory of her husbandman; and Eysteinn in memory of his brother.

runes: ᛅᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᛅᛚᛏᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛂᛘᛁᚾᚴᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫
translit: abiarn ' uk ' inkialtr ' uk ' eminkr ' litu ' rita ' stain ' iftiR ' biarn ' faþr ' sin '
norse: "Ábjôrn ok "Ingjaldr ok "Hemingr létu rétta stein eptir "Bjôrn, fôður sinn.
english: Ábjôrn and Ingjaldr and Hemingr had the stone erected in memory of Bjôrn, their father.

runes: ᚴᚢᛚᛂᚠᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚬᛚᛁ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛁᚴᛁᚠᛅᛋᛏ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛫ ᛁᛅᚱᚢᚾᛏᛅ
translit: kulefr ' uk ' sioli ' litu ' risa ' iftiR ' ikifast ' sun ' iarunta
english: Gulleifr and Sjóli had (the stone) raised in memory of Ingifastr, Jôrundr's/Jôrundi's son.

runes: ᛁᚢᚠᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚢᛁᚴᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ
translit: iufur × lit raisa · stain at · uikbiarn faþur
english: Jôfurr had the stone raised in memory of Vígbjôrn, (his) father.

runes: ᚠᛅᛋᛏᚢᛁ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚴᛅᚱᚦᛅᚱ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚢᛏᛁᚱᛁᚴ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᚬᚾᛅᚱ ᚢᛅᚱᚦ ᛏᛅᚢᚦᚱ ᛁ ᚵᛁᚱᚴᛁᚢᛘ ᛫

english: Fastvé had the stone raised in memory of Gerðarr and Ótryggr, her sons. The other (= the latter) died in Greece.

runes: ᛅᛘᚱᛁᚵᛅᚱ ᚬᛚᚾᚠᚢᛁᚱ ᛬ ᛅᚬᚴ ᚴᛅᛁᛏᛚᚢᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛫ ᛅᚬᚴ ᛫ ᚵᛅᛏᛁᛚᛦᚢᛏᚱ ᛫ ᛅᚬᚵ ᛫ ᛋᚾᛂᚱᛁᛒᛁᛅᚱ ᛭ ᚦᚬᚾ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᚾ ᚢᚢ ᛋᛁᚾ

norse: "Vígi lét reisa stein eptir "Ingjald, fôður sinn. "Jôfurfast.
english: Vígi had the stone raised in memory of Ingjaldr, his father. Jôfurfast.

norse: "Bjôrn ok "Sveinn létu reisa ... "...[fa]st, fôður sinn, ok eptir "Sigdjarf, bróður sinn.
english: Bjôrn and Sveinn had raised ... ...-fastr, their father, and in memory of Sigdjarfr, their brother.

runes: ᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᛘᚢᚾᛏ ᚠᛁᛏ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚤᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᚠᚱᛁᚦ

english: ... had cut in memory of Glóði, their father ...

english: Ósníkinn and Randvé had this stone raised in memory of Stóri.

runes: ᚠᚢᛚᚢᚼᛁ ᛬ ᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛅᛋᚴᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛅᚢᚾ ᛬ ᚼᛁᚬᚾ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛬ ᚼᛅᚴ ᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚴ ᛬ ᚴᚢᛁᚴ ᛬ ᛒᛅᚦᛁ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛅᚾᛏ
translit: fuluhi : uk : askun : þaun : hion : litu : hak a : stain : eftiR : sik : kuik : baþi kuþ hialbi ant
norse: "Fullugi ok "Ásgunnr þau hjón létu hôgg[v]a stein eptir sik kvik bæði. "Guð hjalpi ônd.
english: Fullugi and Ásgunnr, this married couple had the stone cut in memory of themselves while both alive. May God help (their) spirits.

runes: ᛒᚱᚢᛋᛁ ᛫ ᚬᚴ ᚦᚬᚱᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛒ ᚢᚱᚾ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛅᚾᛏ ᚼᛅᚾᛋ

english: Brúsi and Þorbjôrn had the stone raised in memory of their father Bjôrn. May God help his spirit.

runes: ᛒᛂᛚ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛭ ᚼᛅᚴᚢᛅ ᛭ ᛅᛏ ᛭ ᚤᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚴᛁᛚᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛅᛏ ᛭ ᛒᚬᚾᛏᛅ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛚᛁᚴᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛭ ᚼᛁᛅᚴ ᛭

norse: "<bel> lét hôggva at "Eystein, fôður sinn, "Gillaug at bónda sinn. "Líkbjôrn hjó.
english: <bel> had (the stone) cut in memory of Eysteinn, his father; Gillaug in memory of her husbandman. Líkbjôrn cut.

runes: ᚵᚢᚾᛁᛚᚠᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛅᛋᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚴᚢᛏᛅ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾᛅ

english: Gunnelfr had the stone raised in memory of Ásbjôrn and in memory of Goti, her sons.

english: Harðsteinn and Ingileif and Þórunnr had raised ... and Holmfríðr(?) in memory of Agmundr, her husbandman.

runes: ᛭ ᛁᛅᚠᚢᚱᚠᚱᛁᚦ ᚠᛅᛋᛏ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛁᚠᛏᛦ ᛭ ᚠᛅᛋᛏᚢᛚᚠ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦᛅᚾ ᛭

Vébjôrn and Hemkell/Heimkell(?) ... Gunni, their father.

translit: raþ þu : runaR : ret : lit : rista : toliR : bryti : i roþ : kunuki : toliR : auk : gyla : litu : ris : þaun : hion : eftiR k : merki srni hakun · baþ : rista
norse: Ráð þú rúnar. Rétt lét rista "Tólir bryti í róði konungi. "Tólir ok "Gylla létu ris[ta] ..., þau hjón eptir [si]k(?) merki ... "Hákon bað rista.
english: Interpret the runes! Tólir the steward of Roðr had them rightly carved for the King. Tólir and Gylla had [the runes] carved ... this married couple as a landmark in memory of themselves(?) ... Hákon ordered (it) be carved.
... the stone in memory of ...

... and in memory of Styrbjôrn(?).

norse: §A "Hróðleifr ok "Gás ok "Fastlaug létu reisa stein eptir "Guðstein, fôður sinn. §B "Stóðkell bað "Óþvegin hôggva.
english: §A Hróðleifr and Gás and Fastlaug had the stone raised in memory of Guðsteinn, their father. §B Stóðkell ordered Óþveginn to cut.

runes: ᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾᚢᛚᚠᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚵᛂᚱᛅ ᛘᛂᚱᚴᛁ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚦᚬᚱᚬᛏ ᛫

translit: nisuiker ' ok · gyriþ · þo litu · rita meri · yti · sik is · sutu · nasi · ok · kitil · e ' iogu runir a · þisa
norse: "Nes-Végeirr ok "Gyríðr þau létu rétta merki eptir "Sík, er sótdó. "Nasi/"Nesi ok "Ketill [þ]ei[r] hjoggu rúnar á þessa[r].
english: Nes-Végeirr and Gyríðr, they had the landmark erected in memory of Síkr, who died from sickness. Nasi/Nesi and Ketill, they cut these runes on (it).
... had ... Sigfastr, (his) father ...

runes: ᛁᚢᚱᚢᚾᛏᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚤᚾᛁᚢᛚᚠᚱ ᛫ ᛁᚴᛁᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᛅᛋᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚤᛒᛁᛦ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁ

norse: "Jôrundr ok "Brynjulfr, "Ingifastr létu reisa stein at "Ásbjôrn, fôður sinn. "Œpir risti.
english: Jôrundr and Brynjulfr (and) Ingifastr had the stone raised in memory of Ásbjôrn, their father. Œpir carved.

runes: ᚵᛁᛚᚬᚴ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛂᚾ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛭ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛂᚾ ᛭ ᚠᛅᛋᛏᛅᚱ ᛭ ᛋᚴᛅᛚᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᛋᚤᛋᛚᛅ ᛘᛂᚱᚴᛁ ᛫ ᚢᛂᛚ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚦᚬᚱᚦᚱ ᛫ ᚬᚴ ᛫ ᛅᚦᛁᛋ ᛭
translit: gilok lit + rita + sten eftiR + sun sen + fastar + skalti ÷ lit ' sysla merki ' uel ÷ ok ÷ þorþr ' ok ' aþis +
norse: "Gillaug lét rétta stein eptir son sinn "Fastar. "Skaldi lét sýsla merki vel ok "Þórðr ok "Ádís(?).
english: Gillaug had the stone erected in memory of her son Fastarr. Skaldi had the landmark arranged well, and Þórðr and Ádís (did?).

Gísl ...

runes: ᛁᚴᚱᛁᚦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᛚᛅᚦᛒᚬ ᛫ ᚴᛁᛅᚱᛅ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚼᛅᚴᚢᛅ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛁᚴᛁᛘᛅᚱ ᛒᚬᛏᛅ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛅᚱ ᛫ ᛏᛅᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛫ ᛒᛅᚴᛅ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾᛅ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛒᚤᚴᚢ ᛫ ᛁ ᚱᚤᚾᛒᚤ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛒᚬ ᛅᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚴᚱᛁᛋᛏᚱ ᛫ ᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛅᛚᚢ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᚱ ᛫ ᚦᛁᛏ ᛋᚴᛅᛚ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛘᛁᚾᚢᛘ ᛫ ᛘᛅᚾᛅ ᛫ ᛘᛁᚦᛅᚾ ᛫ ᛘᛁᚾ ᛚᛁᚠᛅ
translit: ikriþ ' lit · laþbo · kiara ' auk · stain · hakua eftir ikimar bota sin · auk · eftar · tan · auk · eftir · baka · suni · sina ' þaiR byku ' i rynby ' auk ' bo atu ' kristr · ialbi ' salu · þair · þit skal ' at minum · mana ' miþan · min lifa
norse: §A "Ingríðr lét hlaðbrú gera ok stein hôggva eptir "Ingimar, bónda sinn, ok eptir "Dan ok eptir "Banka/"Bagga, sonu sína. §B Þeir bjoggu í "Runbý ok bú áttu. "Kristr hjalpi sálu þeir[a]. Þat skal at minnum manna, meðan menn lifa.
english: §A Ingríðr had the causeway made and the stone cut in memory of Ingimarr, her husbandman, and in memory of Danr, and in memory of Banki/Baggi(?), her sons. §B They lived in Runbýr and owned the estate. May Christ help their souls. That will (stand) in memory of the men while man lives.

runes: ᚠᛅᛋᛏᚴᛅᛁᛦ ᚠᛅᛋᛏᛚᛅᚢᚴ ᛅᛏ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚼᛅᚴᚢᛅ ᛅᛏ ᚾᛂᚠᚴᛅᛁᚱ
translit: fastkaiR fastlauk at sun sin litu hakua at nefkair
norse: "Fastgeirr, "Fastlaug at son sinn létu hôggva, at "Nefgeir.
english: Fastgeirr (and) Fastlaug had (the stone) cut in memory of Nefgeirr, in memory of their son.

runes: ᛚ ᛂᛁᚱ ᛏ ᛭ ᚴᛁᛏ ᛒᚱᛅ ᛋ ᚾᛁ ᛅᚾ ᛏᛁ ᛫ ᚢ ᚼᛚᛁ

norse: "Fastulfr lét rétta steina eptir "Hvíthôfða, fôður sinn. "Ásmundr risti ok "Vígmarr.
english: Fastulfr had the stones erected in memory of Hvíthôfði, his father. Ásmundr carved and Vígmarr.

runes: ᚴᛚᛁᚾᛏᚱ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛒᛚᛁᚴᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛋᛁ ᛫ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚴᚢᚾᚢᛁᚦ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚼᛅᚾ ᛭ ᚠᚬᛦ ᛒᚬᚱᛏ ᛘᛁᚦ ᛁᚴᚢᛅᚱᛁ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛏᚱᚢᛏᛁᚾ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᚬᚾᛏ ᚱᛅ ᛫ ᚴᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁᚾᛅ ᚦᚢᚱᛁᛦ ᛭ ᛏᚱᚬᚾᛁ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛭
translit: klintr auk blikr × ristu stin × þinsi · iftiR kunuiþ × faþur × sin + han × foR bort miþ ikuari + kuþ trutin hialbi ont ra · kristina þuriR + troni × risti +
norse: "Klettr(?) ok "Bleikr reistu stein þenna eptir "Gunnvið, fôður sinn. Hann fór burt með "Ingvari. "Guð dróttinn hjalpi ônd [all]ra kristinna. "Þórir "Trani risti.
english: Klettr(?) and Bleikr raised this stone in memory of Gunnviðr, their father. He travelled away with Ingvarr. May Lord God help the spirits of all Christians. Þórir the Crane carved.

runes: ᛫ ᚴᛅᛁᛦᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚼᚢᚾᛁᚠᚱᛅᛦ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚼᚱᛅᚠᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚠᚢᛚᚴᛒᛁᚢᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚦᚢᚱᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛋᛏᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚴᛅᛁᛦᛅ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛅᚾ ᚼᚬᚾᛋ ᛫ ᚬᛋᛘᚢᚾᛏᚱ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᚼᛁᚱᛁᛅᛦ ᛫
translit: ' kaiRfastr auk hunifraR auk hrafn ' auk ' fulkbiurn ' auk þuriR ' litu rita stino ' aftiR ' kaiRa faþur sin ' kuþ hialbi an hons ' osmuntr risti ' uk hiriaR '
norse: "Geirfastr ok "Hónefr(?)/"Hýnifrár(?) ok "Hrafn ok "Folkbjôrn ok "Þórir létu rétta steina eptir "Geira, fôður sinn. "Guð hjalpi ôn[d] hans. "Ásmundr risti ok "Herjarr(?).
english: Geirfastr and Hónefr(?)/Hýnifrár(?) and Hrafn and Folkbjôrn and Þórir had the stones erected in memory of Geiri, their father. May God help his spirit. Ásmundr carved and Herjarr(?).

runes: ᛬ ᚱᛁᚴᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᛅᛒᛏᛁᛦ ᚠᛅᛋᛏᛅ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚦᛅᚢᚼ ᚴᚢᚾᚦᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᚼᚬᚾᛋ ᛋᛅᛚᚢ ᚢᚴ ᚴᚢᚦᛋ ᛘᚢᚦᛁᛦ
translit: : rikr ' lit raisa stain þino ' abtiR fasta faþur sin auk þauh kunþruþr ' kuþ hialbi hons salu uk kuþs muþiR

english: Ríkr had this stone raised in memory of Fasti, his father, and Gunnþrúðr (also raised). May God and God's mother help his soul.

translit: raþulfr : auk : funtin : auk : anuntra : bruþr : ritu : stain : þinsa : abtir : kara : faþur : sin : in : mal:sbaka : sun : uks : i · suanobu :
norse: "Ráðulfr ok "Fundinn ok "Ônundr, brœðr, réttu stein þenna eptir "Kára, fôður sinn, hinn málspaka, son "Uggs í "Svanabý.
english: Ráðulfr and Fundinn and Ônundr, the brothers erected this stone in memory of Kári the Eloquent, their father, the son of Uggr of Svanabýr.

runes: ᚾᛋᛁ ᛫ ᚢᚼᛅ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛅᚱᚠᚢᚾᛏᚱ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚴᚢᚦᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛋᚴᛅ ᚾᚦᚴ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚼᛅᚾ ᚢᛅᛋ ᛫ ᛋᚢᛁᚴᚾ ᛅᚾᛋ

translit: þurbiurn ' auk knutr ' þaiR litu ritau stain þino oftiR ' kaiRmunta faþur sin kuþ hialbi hons salu uk kuþs muþiR ' suain ouk osmunrt markaþu stin þino
norse: "Þorbjôrn ok "Knútr þeir létu rétta stein þenna eptir "Geirmunda/"Geirmund, fôður sinn. "Guð hjalpi hans sálu ok "Guðs móðir. "Sveinn ok "Ásmundr môrkuðu stein þenna.
english: Þorbjôrn and Knútr, this had this stone erected in memory of Geirmundi/Geirmundr, their father. May God and God's mother help his soul. Sveinn and Ásmundr marked this stone.

runes: ᚠᛁᚾᚢᛁᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛫ ᚱᛅᚼᚾᚠᚱᛁᚦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱ ᛫ ᛋᚢᛘ ᛫ ᚼᛅᛏᛁ ᛫ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᚴᛁᛅᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛏ ᛁᚱ ᚴᚢᛁᚴᛋ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚠᛁᚾᚢᛁ

english: §A ... Finnviðr, Ragnfríðr's son, had ... §B ... who owned (i.e., was married to) Ingigerðr and ... §C ... Kvikr's and Finnviðr's ...

runes: ᛭ ᚼᛅᚦᛁᚾᛏᛁᛋ ᛭ ᛚᛅ ᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛅᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚼᚢᛚᛘᚠᛅᛋᛏ ᛭ ᛒᚢᛏᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛅᛏ ᛭ ᛅᚴᛚᛅ ᛭ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛭ ᚼᛁᛅ ᛒᛁ ᛭ ᚬᛏ ᛭ ᚦᛅᛁᚱᛅ ᛭

norse: "Heðindís lé[t rei]sa stein þenna eptir "Holmfast, bónda sinn, ok at "Engla/"Egla, son sinn. "Guð hja[l]pi ônd þeira.
english: Heðindís had this stone raised in memory of Holmfastr, her husbandman, and in memory of Engli/Egli, her son. May God help their spirits.

runes: ᛭ ᛂᚱᛚᚤᚵ ᛭ ᛚᛂᛏ ᛅᚴᚢᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛂᚾ ᛭ ᛦᚠᛏᛁ ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛏᛂᚾ ᛭ ᛒᚢᚬᚾᛏᛅ ᛋᛂᚾ ᛭ ᛚᛁᚠᛋᛏᛂᚾ ᛭

norse: "Ernlaug lét hôggva stein eptir "Þorstein, bónda sinn. "Hlífsteinn.
english: Ernlaug had the stone cut in memory of Þorsteinn, her husbandman. Hlífsteinn.

runes: ᚢᚾᚢ ᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚴᛅᛘᛅᛚ ᛭ ᛒᚢᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ
translit: unu r + raisti + stin + þina + aftir + kamal + buruþur + sin
norse: "Unnu[lf]r(?) reisti stein þenna eptir "Gamal, bróður sinn.
english: Unnulfr(?) raised this stone in memory of Gamall, his brother.

runes: ᚠᚱᚢᚴᛅᚦᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᛁᚼᚢᛚ ᛭ ᛒᚢᛅᛏᛅ ᛋᛁᚾ

norse: "Freygerðr reisti stein þenna eptir "Ígul, bónda sinn.
english: Freygerðr raised this stone in memory of Ígull, her husbandman.

runes: ᚼᚢᚱᚢᛚᚠᚱ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛒᛅᚼᚱᛏᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛋᚴᚢᛚᚠ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛚᛒᛁ ᛭ ᛅᚾᛏ ᛭ ᚼᛅᚾᛋ
translit: hurulfr + auk + bahrtr + raistu + stain + aftir + raskulf + kuþ hilbi + ant + hans
norse: "Hrólfr ok "Bjartr(?) reistu stein eptir "Rôskulf. "Guð hjalpi ônd hans.
english: Hrólfr and Bjartr(?) raised the stone in memory of Raskulfr. May God help his spirit.

runes: ᛋᚾᚬᚱᛁᚱ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚱᚢᚴᚱ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚼᛅᚱᛁᚢᛚᚠ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᛁ
translit: snorir + auk + kurukr × raistu + stain + þina + aftir + hariulf × aftir × faþur + sii
norse: "Snorrir/"Snerrir ok "Krókr reistu stein þenna eptir "Herjulf, eptir fôður sinn.
english: Snorrir/Snerrir and Krókr raised this stone in memory of Herjulfr, in memory of their father.

runes: ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᚱ ᛭ ᚼᛅᛚᚠᛏᛅᚾ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛭ ᛅᚾᛏ ᛭ ᚼᛅᚾᛋ
translit: þurstain + raisti + stain + þina + aftir + halftan × kuþ halbi + ant × hans
norse: "Þorsteinn reisti stein þenna eptir "Halfdan. "Guð hjalpi ônd hans.
english: Þorsteinn raised this stone in memory of Halfdan. May God help his spirit.

runes: ᛬ ᚴᚢᛁᛋᚦᛂᚾ ᛬ ᚤᚵ ᛬ ᛂᛋᛏᚱ ᛬ ᚤᚵ ᛬ ᚢᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚤᚴ ᛬ ᛅᚴᛁ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᚾ ᛬ ᚠᚱᚤᚴᛂ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛂ ᛬ ᛚᚠᛋᛏᛂᚾ ᛬ ᛁᚢᚴ ᛬ ᚱᚢᚾᛁ ᛬ ᚦᛋᛅ ᛬
translit: : kuisþen : yg : estr : yg : uin : yk : aki : litu : risa : stn : fryke : faþur se : lfsten : iuk : runi : þsa :

english: Guðsteinn(?) and Eistr and ... and Áki had the stone raised in memory of Freygeirr, their father. Hlífsteinn cut these runes.

english: Finnviðr raised this stone in memory of his brother Þórðr, Þjalfi's son. May God and God's mother help his spirit. He made the bridge in memory of his brother and (so did) Ása, their mother.

english: Þegn and Gautdjarfr(?) and Sunnhvatr(?) and Þórulfr, they had this stone raised in memory of Tóki, their father. He perished abroad in Greece. May God help his spirit, spirit and soul.

english: (They) raised the stones and worked(?) the staff also, the mighty one, as marks of honour. Gyríðr also cherished her husband: he will therefore be commemorated in weeping. Gunnarr cut the stone.

english: Halfdan and Tobbi/Tubbi had the stone raised in memory of Oddi, their father, Þorbjôrn's son. Œpir carved the runes.

english: Gerðarr and Fullugi and Sigreifr(?) and Sibbi and Sighvatr, these brothers have raised this stone in memory of their father Ulfr and (in memory of) Sveinn their brother. May God help ...

translit: tan auk huskarl + auk suain + auk hulmfriþr × þaun miþkin litu rita stin þino × aftiR halftan + faþur þaiRa tans ' auk humfriþr at buanta sin

english: Danr and Húskarl and Sveinn and Holmfríðr, the mother and (her) sons, had this stone erected in memory of Halfdan, the father of Danr and his brothers; and Holmfríðr in memory of her husbandman.

translit: n tan auk huskarl ' auk suain ' litu rita stin aftiR ' ulfrik ' faþurfaþur sino ' hon hafþi o onklanti tuh kialt takit + kuþ hialbi þiRa kiþka salu uk kuþs muþi
norse: En "Danr ok "Húskarl ok "Sveinn létu rétta stein eptir "Ulfrík, fôðurfôður sinn. Hann hafði á "Englandi tvau gjald tekit. "Guð hjalpi þeira feðga sálu ok "Guðs móðir.
english: And Danr and Húskarl and Sveinn had the stone erected in memory of Ulfríkr, their father's father. He had taken two payments in England. May God and God's mother help the souls of the father and son.
... and ... raise ...

translit: holmlauk · uk · holmfrþ · lata · reisa · steina · eftR · fasta · uk · shfast · sunu · sina · þiR · to i hoitauaþum
norse: "Holmlaugr ok "Holmfríðr láta reisa steina eptir "Fasta ok "Sigfast, sonu sína. Þeir dóu í hvítaváðum.
english: Holmlaugr and Holmfríðr have raised the stones in memory of Fasti and Sigfastr, their sons. They died in (their) christening robes.

norse: Ráð þú! "Geirmundr [f]ekk "Geirlaug meydómi í. Þá fingu þau son, áðan hann druknaði. En sonr dó síðan. Þá fekk ho[n] "[Gu]ðrík. Ha[nn] ... þenna. Þá fingu þau bôrn.  En mær ein lifði; hon hét "[In]ga. Ha[na] fekk "Ragnfastr í "Snotastôðum. Þá varð hann dauðr ok sonr síðan. En móðir kvam at sonar arfi. Þá fekk hon "Eirík. Þar varð hon dauð. Þar kvam "Geirlaug at arfi "Ingu, dóttur sinnar. "Þorbjôrn "Skald risti rúnar.
english: Interpret! Geirmundr got Geirlaug (to wife) in her maidenhood. Then they got a son, before he (= Geirmundr) drowned. And then the son died. Then she got Guðríkr. He ... this. Then they got children. And one maid lived; she was called Inga. Ragnfastr of Snotastaðir got her (to wife). Then he died, and thereafter the son. And the mother came to inherit from her son. Then she got Eiríkr. Then she died. Then Geirlaug came to inherit from Inga, her daughter. Þorbjôrn Skald carved the runes.
...-fari had raised ... ...-lugi, father ...

norse: "Hemingr ok "Sjalfi ok "Jóhan þeir láta hôggva eptir fôður sinn "Finnvið, ok "Vargas(?)/"Varghôss(?) ok "Ragnfríðr, ok móður sína, ok at "Ingigerði ok at "Kalf ok "Gerðar o[k] "<...-at>. Hann átti einn alt fyrst. Þat váru frændr þeira. "Guð hjalpi ônd þeira. "Véseti risti rúnar þessar.
english: Hemingr and Sjalfi and Jóhan, they have cut (the stone) in memory of their father Finnviðr and Vargas(?)/Varghôss(?) and Ragnfríðr and their mother, and in memory of Ingigerðr and in memory of Kalfr and Gerðarr and ... He alone owned all at first. These were their kinsmen. May God help their spirits. Véseti carved these runes.

norse: §A "Þorsteinn ok "Ragnfríðr þau reistu stein þenna eptir "Bjôrn í "Granbý, §B bróður "Kalfs. Honum vá at "Vígm[un]dr. "Guð hjalpi hans ônd ok sálu betr en hann gerði [t]il.
english: §A Þorsteinn and Ragnfríðr, they raised this stone in memory of Bjôrn in Granbýr, §B Kalfr's brother. Vígmundr slaughtered him. May God help his spirit and soul better than he deserved.
... Tófa/Tófi and ... may help (his) spirit ...

english: Sveinn and Halfdan and Þóra had this stone raised in memory of Víkingr, their father, and in memory of Þegn, their brother. May God help their spirits.
... had ... Sveinn/Steinn and ...

english: Ingjaldr(?) had this stone raised in memory of Kalfr, his father, and in memory of Ígull, his brother, and in memory of Ragnvé, his mother/maid. May God and God's mother now help their souls.
... this stone in memory of Kalfr, brother ...

english: Karsi and ... they had this stone raised in memory of Ulfr, their father. May God help his ... and God's mother.

english: And Ulfr has taken three payments in England. That was the first that Tosti paid. Then Þorketill paid. Then Knútr paid.

norse: "Ragnfríðr lét rétta stein þenna eptir "Bjôrn, son þeira "Ketilmundar. Hann fell á "Virlandi. "Guð hjalpi hans ônd ok "Guðs móðir. "Ásmundr markaði rúnar réttar.
english: Ragnfríðr had this stone erected in memory of Bjôrn, her son and Ketilmundr's. He fell in Virland. May God and God's mother help his spirit. Ásmundr marked the right runes.

norse: "Hlífsteinn lét gera sér til sálubótar ok sinni konu "Ingirún ok sínum sonum "Jôrundr ok "Nikulás ok "Loðinn brúar.
english: Hlífsteinn had the bridges made for himself for the salvation of his soul and that of his wife Ingirún and of their sons Jôrundr and Nikulás and Loðinn.

english: He owned an estate in Þorsholmr and a ship's retinue in Hrólfsstaðir.

norse: "Véketill ok "Ôzurr [lét]u reisa stein þenna eptir "Eystein, fôð[ur] ... [gó]ðan. Hann fórst úti með alla skipan. "Guð hjalpi ônd.
english: Véketill and Ôzurr had this stone raised in memory of Eysteinn, ... good father. He perished abroad with all the seamen. May God help (his) spirit.

english: Aðísl and Ásl/Ôsl and Ólafr, they had this stone raised in memory of Végísl, their father, Ernfríðr's husbandman.

english: Bjôrn and Ásgeirr have raised the stone in memory of their father; and Lokkr(?) in memory of (her) father's father Órœkja.

norse: "Siglaug lét steina rétta eptir "Sigvið, son sinn.
english: Siglaug had the stones erected in memory of Sigviðr, her son.

runes: ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᚾ ᛫ ᚬᚴ ᚴᛁᛅᚱᚦᛁ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚬ ᛫᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚼᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛅᚴ ᛫ ᚦᛁᛅᚼᚾ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁ ᛫
translit: suni · riti · stan · ok kiarþi · bro ·· eftiR · sihbiarn · ak · þiahn suni · risti ·
norse: "Soni rétti stein ok gerði brú eptir "Sigbjôrn ok "Þegn. "Soni risti.
english: Soni erected the stone and made the bridge in memory of Sigbjôrn and Þegn. Soni carved.

runes: ᚴᚢᛚᛅᚢᚼ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚼᚢᛚᛘᛅ ᛬ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛅᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛁᚾᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛅᚠᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛋᚢᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚢᛅᚠᚱᛅ ᛬ ᛅᚱᚠᚢᛅ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛬ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛫ ᛅᚾᛏ ᚼ᛬ᛅᚾᛋ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚴᚢᛋ ᛘ
translit: kulauh · auk · hulma : litu : arisa : stain : þinsa : afti : suin : bruþur : sin : uafra : arfua kuþ : hialbi · ant h:ans : auk kus m
norse: "Gullaug ok "Holma létu reisa stein þenna eptir "Svein, bróður sinn, "Vafra arfa. "Guð hjalpi ônd hans ok "Guðs m[óðir].
english: Gullaug and Holma had this stone raised in memory of Sveinn, their brother, Vafri's heir. May God and God's mother help his spirit.

runes: ᚢᛚᛘᚠᚱᛁᚦ ᛭ ᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚢᛚᛘᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛭ ᛒᚢᚾᛏᛅ ᛭ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦᚱᛁᚴᛋ ᛭ ᛁ ᛘᚤᚱᛁᛒᚤ ᛒᚢᚴᛁ
translit: ulmfriþ + uk + ulmfastr + bunta + bruþur + sin sun + kuþriks + i myriby buki
norse: "Holmfríðr ok "Holmfastr ... bónda, bróður sinn, son "Guðríks, í "Mýribý bjó.
english: Holmfríðr and Holmfastr ... husbandman, their brother, Guðríkr's son, (who) lived in Mýribýr.

runes: ᚱᛅᚼᚾᚠᚱᛁᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱᛅᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛒᛁᚢᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾ ᚦᛅᛁᛦᛅ ᛫ ᚴᛁᛏᛁᛚᛘᚢᚾᛏᛅᛦ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛘᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᚼᚬᚾᛋ ᛅᚾᛏ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚴᚢᚦᛋ ᛘᚢᚦᛁᛦ ᚼᚬᚾ ᚠᛁᛚ ᛅ ᚢᛁᚱᛚᛅᚾᛏᛁ ᛫ ᛁᚾ ᚬᛋᛘᚢᚾᛏᚱ ᛘᛅᚱᚴᛅᚦᛁ
translit: rahnfriþr ' lit rasa stain þino ' aftiR biurn · sun þaiRa · kitilmuntaR ' kuþ mialbi hons ant auk kuþs muþiR hon fil a uirlanti · in osmuntr markaþi
norse: "Ragnfríðr lét reisa stein þenna eptir "Bjôrn, son þeira "Ketilmundar. "Guð hjalpi hans ônd ok "Guðs móðir. Hann fell á "Virlandi. En "Ásmundr markaði.
english: Ragnfríðr had this stone raised in memory of Bjôrn, her son and Ketilmundr's. May God and God's mother help his spirit. He fell in Virland. And Ásmundr marked.

runes: ᛬ ᚢᛅᚱᚼᛅᛋ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛅᚱᚾ ᛁᛚ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᚬᚾᛏᚢᛁᛏᚱ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᚼᚱᚢᚦᛅᛁᛚᚠᚱ ᛫ ᛘᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᚦᛁᛦᛅ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛦ ᚦᚱᛁᛦ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾᚬ ᚦᛁᛋᛅ ᛅᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚼᚢᛚᛘᛅ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ
translit: ÷ uarhas ' uk arn il ' uk ontuitr ' uk hruþailfr ' muþur þiRa ' þaR þriR bruþr ' litu ' rita ' staino þisa aftiR hulma faþur sin
norse: "Vargas(?)/"Varghôss(?) ok "Arn[k]ell ok "Andvéttr ok "Hróðelfr, móðir/móður þeira, þeir þrír brœðr létu rétta steina þessa eptir "Holma, fôður sinn.
english: Vargas(?)/Varghôss(?) and Arnkell and Andvéttr and Hróðelfr their mother/mother's, these three brothers had these stones erected in memory of Holmi, their father.

runes: ᚠᚢᛚᚴᛘᛅᚱ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛭ ᚠᚢᛚᚴᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛭ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛋᛅᛦ ᛭ ᛁᛏᛅᚦᛁᛋ ᛭ ᚢᚴ ᛘᛁᚦ ᚴᚱᚴᚢᛘ ᛭ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛭ ᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛭ ᛅᚾᛋ ᛭ ᚬᛏ ᚢᚴ ᛋᛅᛚᚢ
translit: fulkmar × lit × risa × stin × þina × iftiR × fulkbiarn × sun × sin × saR × itaþis × uk miþ krkum × kuþ × ialbi × ans × ot uk salu
norse: "Folkmarr lét reisa stein þenna eptir "Folkbjôrn, son sinn. Sá endaðist ok með "Grikkjum. "Guð hjalpi hans ônd ok sálu.
english: Folkmarr had this stone raised in memory of Folkbjôrn, his son. He also met his end among the Greeks. May God help his spirit and soul.

runes: ᚴᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛘᛁᚾᛅ ᛫ ᛁ ᚴᛁᛘᛏ ᛁᛦ ᚾᚢ ᛫ ᛁ
translit: kiftiR ' mina ' i kimt iR nu ' i
norse: giptir minna. Æ geymt er nú [merk]i(?)/[minn]i(?).
english: ... remember gifts. Ever protected is now the landmark(?)/memorial(?).

runes: ᛁᚾᚴᛁᛘᚬᚦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾᛅ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚬ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚴᛅᚱᛚ ᛒᚬᛅᚾᛏᛅ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚤᛒᛁᛦ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᛁ
translit: inkimoþ ' lit ' raisa ' staina ' uk ' bro ' eftiR ' karl boanta sin ybiR risti
norse: "Ingimóð lét reisa steina ok brú eptir "Karl, bónda sinn. "Œpir risti.
english: Ingimóð had the stones raised and (made the) bridge in memory of Karl, her husbandman. Œpir carved.

runes: ᛭ ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚼᛁᛅᚴ ᛭ ᛅ ᚼᛁᛚᛁ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛂᚱᛁᚾᛘᚢᚾᛏ ᛭ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᚴᛅᛁᛦᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁᚾ
translit: + þurstain × hiak × a hili iftiR erinmunt × sun × sin × auk × iftiR kaiRbiarn × faþur × sin
norse: "Þorsteinn hjó á helli eptir "Erinmund, son sinn, ok eptir "Geirbjôrn, fôður sinn.
english: Þorsteinn cut on the rock-slab in memory of Erinmundr, his son, and in memory of Geirbjôrn, his father.

runes: ᛂᚱᛂᚠᛅᛋᛏ ᛫ ᛅᛏᛅᛚᛅ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᚴᛏᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᚾᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᛒᛁᚼᚱᚾ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚼᚢᛚᛘᛅ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ
translit: erefast ' atala + auk · stain þaiR · litu · rkta staniR · at · bihrn ' uk ' hulma ' rita
norse: "Ernfastr, "Atla(?) ok "Steinn þeir létu rétta stein(?) at "Bjôrn, ok "Holma rétti.
english: Ernfastr, Atla(?) and Steinn, they had the stone(?) erected in memory of Bjôrn. And Holma (also) erected.

runes: ᚴᛁᛏᛁᛚᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛫ ᚾᛁᚴᛋ ᚢᚠᛅᛁᚼᚱ ᛁᚢᛏᚱ ᛭ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛭ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᛅᛚᛏᛁ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫
translit: kitilfastr ' niks ufaihr iutr × þaiR × litu ' stain × iftiR × inkialti × faþur sin ·
norse: "Ketilfastr, "Nefr(?), "Ófeigr "<--iutr> þeir létu stein eptir "Ingjald, fôður sinn.
english: Ketilfastr, Nefr(?), Ófeigr ... they had the stone (raised) in memory of Ingjaldr, their father.

runes: ᚴᛁᛋᛚᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᚼᛅᚴᚢᛅ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛋᛒᛁᛅᛚᛏᛒᚢᚦᛁ ᛫ ᚢᛚᚠᚱ ᛫ ᛁᚴᚢᛅᚱ ᛫ ᚼᚢᛚᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛫ ᚴᛅᛁᚱᛁ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛒᚱᚬᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚦᛁᛅᚴᚾ ᛫ ᚠᚬᚱᛋ ᛫ ᚢᛏᛁ ᚬᚴ ᛫ ᛅᛏ ᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛒᚱᚬ ᚴᛁᚱᚦᚢ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛋᛁᛚᚢ
translit: kislauk · lit · hakua · at sun sin · sbialtbuþi · ulfr · ikuar · hulfastr · kairi · þaiR · at broþur · sin · þiakn · fors · uti ok · at biarn faþur sin bro kirþu · kuþ hialbi silu
norse: "Gíslaug lét hôggva at son sinn, "Spjallboði, "Ulfr, "Ingvarr, "Holmfastr, "Geiri, þeir at bróður sinn "Þegn, fórst úti, ok at "Bjôrn, fôður sinn. Brú gerðu. "Guð hjalpi sálu.
english: Gíslaug had (this) cut in memory of her son; Spjallboði, Ulfr, Ingvarr, Holmfastr, Geiri, they made the bridge in memory of their brother Þegn, (who) perished abroad, and in memory of Bjôrn, their father. May God help (their) souls.

runes: ᚴᛅᚱᛋᛁ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛫ ᚴᛅᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚼᛅᚾ ᚢᛅᛦ ᛏᛅᚢᚦᚱ ᛁ ᛫ ᚼᚢᛁᛏᛅᚢᛅᚦᚢᛘ
translit: karsi · auk ' kar sin ' han uaR tauþr i ' huitauaþum
norse: "Karsi ok "<kar-...> ... sinn. Hann var dauðr í hvítaváðum.
english: Karsi and Kar-... their ... He died in christening robes.
... the stone cut in memory of ...
... died on the eastern route ...
... this stone erected in memory of ...

runes: ᛫ ᚢᚴᛅᚢᛏᚢ ᛅᛁᛦ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛁ ᚾᛏᚱ ᛫ ᛘᛅᚱᚴ
translit: · ukautu aiR litu i ntr · mark
english: ... they had ... And(?) Ásmundr marked ...

translit: + utrykr + auk + buanti + auk + alfrikr + raistu + stain + þinsa + eftiR + kara + faþur + sin + auk + guneþr + at + buanta + sin · guþ hialbi a ans + þurbiurn + hiuk ' runaR
norse: "Ótryggr ok "Bóndi ok "Alfríkr reistu stein þenna eptir "Kára, fôður sinn, ok "Gunnheiðr at bónda sinn. "Guð hjalpi ô[nd h]ans. "Þorbjôrn hjó rúnar.
english: Ótryggr and Bóndi and Alfríkr raised this stone in memory of Kári, their father; and Gunnheiðr in memory of her husbandman. May God help his spirit. Þorbjôrn cut the runes.

runes: ᛭ ᚬᛒᛘᚾᚦᛁᛋᛅ ᛬ ᚴᛚᚠᛅᛁ ᛁ ᛬ ᛁᛋ ᛚᚦᛦᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛁᛅᚼᚦᚦ ᛬ ᚬᚦᚾᛏᛁᚢᛁᛚᚴᛁᚠ ᛬ ᛬ ᛁᚴᛚᛦᚦᚠ

runes: ᚴᛁᛏᛁᛚ ᛭ ᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛒᚱᚢᚾᚴᛁᛏᛁᛚ ᚦᛁᛦ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛦ ᛭ ᚢᛚᚠ ᛭ ᛁ ᛚᚢᚴᚬᛒᚱᛁ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛭ ᛋᛁ ᛚᛒᛁ ᛭ ᛅᚾᛋ ᛭ ᚬᛏ ᚢᚴ ᛭ ᛋᛅᛚ ᚢᚦᛁᛦ ᛒᛁᛏᚱ ᛭ ᚦᛅᚾ ᚼᚾ ᛭ ᚴᛁᚱᚦᛁ ᛏᛁᛚ
translit: kitil × uk × brunkitil þiR × ristu × stin × þina × R × ulf × i lukobri × faþur × si lbi × ans × ot uk × sal uþiR bitr × þan hn × kirþi til
norse: "Ketill ok "Brúnketill þeir reistu stein þenna [epti]r "Ulf í "Laughamri(?), fôður si[nn] ... "[Guð hja]lpi hans ônd ok sál[u ok "Guðs m]óðir betr en hann gerði til.
english: Ketill and Brúnketill, they raised this stone in memory of Ulfr of Laughamarr(?), their father ... May God and God's mother help his spirit and soul better than he deserved.

runes: ᚦᚢᚱᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᚦᛁᚼᚾ ᛫ ᚢᚴ ᛋᛁᛅᛚᚠᛁ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᛘ ᚼᛁᛏ ᚴᛁᛚᛅ ᛘᚢᚦᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᚬ ᚬᛒᛏᛁᛦ ᛋᛁᚼᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᚼᚬᚾᛋ ᛋᛅᛚ
translit: þurstain ' uk þihn ' uk sialfi ' þaim hit kila muþiR ' þaiR litu rita stain þino obtiR sihat ' faþur sin ' kuþ hialbi hons sal
norse: "Þorsteinn ok "Þegn ok "Sjalfi, þeim hét "Gilla móðir, þeir létu rétta stein þenna eptir "Sighvat, fôður sinn. "Guð hjalpi hans sál.
english: Þorsteinn and Þegn and Sjalfi - their mother was called Gilla - they had this stone erected in memory of Sighvatr, their father. May God help his soul.

runes: ᛁᛅᚱᛒᛁ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛫ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚼᛏᛏᛦ ᛫ ᛋᚢ ᛋᛁᚾᛅ ᛫ ᛏᚢᛅ
translit: iarbi · lit · stain · httR · su sina · tua
norse: "Jarpi lét stein eptir so[nu] sína tvá.
english: Jarpi had the stone (raised) in memory of his two sons.

runes: ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚱᛁᛏᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᚬ ᚼᚢ ᛅᚾ ᚼᚬᚾ ᚠᛁᛚ ᚬ ᚴᚱᛁᚴᛚᚬᚾᛏᚱ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁ ᛚᛒᛁ ᛋᛅᛚ
translit: litu ' rita : stain þino · iftiR · o hu an hon fil o kriklontr kuþ hi lbi sal
norse: ... létu rétta stein þenna eptir "... ... Hann fell á "Grikklandi. "Guð hj[a]lpi sál[u].
english: ... had this stone erected in memory of ... He fell in Greece. May God help (his) soul.

english: Sigfastr and Ginnlaug, they had this stone erected in memory of Vinaman, their son. And he died in Bógi(?).

english: Inga had the bridge made and the stones erected in memory of Ragni, her son; and Ragnhildr in memory of her husbandman. Steinn carved.

english: Gunnarr and Ketiley had the stone erected and the bridge made in memory of Ólaug, their daughter. And Sveinn carved the runes.

english: Sveinn and Ígulfastr, they erected the stone and made the bridge in memory of Ígull, their father and Áselfr, their mother.

norse: "Tófa ok "Hemingr létu rétta stein þenna eptir "Gunnar, son sinn. En  hann var dau[ð]r með "Grikkjum út. "Guð hjalpi hans sálu ok "Guðs m[óð]ir.
english: Tófa and Hemingr had this stone erected in memory of Gunnarr, their son, and he died abroad among the Greeks. May God and God's mother help his soul.

runes: ᚢᛁᚴᛁᚾᚴᚱ ᛚᛁᛏ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛅᛏ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᛋᛁᚾᛅ ᚴᚱᚢᚴ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛅᛋᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛋᚢᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᛋᛁ ᚢᛅᚱ ᛋᚢᚾᛁ ᚴᛁ ᛏ ᚴᛁᚱᚦᛅ

... had ... made ... Ketill, father ...

norse: "Þorkell ok "Sjafi létu reisa steinhall/steinhelli ... ... góðan, ok "Heðinfast, kona hans. "Guð hjalpi ônd hans ok "Guðs móðir.
english: Þorkell and Sjafi had the stone-slab(?) raised ... the good, and Heðinfast, his wife. May God and God's mother help his spirit.
Freyríkr had ... and in memory of ...

runes: ᚴᚢᚾᛅ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛋᚢᛏᛅᚱᛁ ᛬ ᚱᛁᛋᛏᚢ ᛬ ᛋᛏ ᛋᛁᚴᛒᛁᛅᚱ ᛋᛅᛏᛁ ᛬ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛅᛚᛘᚤᚴᛁᚾ ᛬ ᛁ ᛬ ᛋ

english: Gunna and Sútari raised the stone ... Sigbjôrn placed the very great stone in ... in memory of his father.

runes: ᚱᚬᚾᛏᚱ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚱᛁᚴᛁ ᛫ ᛅᚢᚴ ᚴᚢᚦᚱᚢᚾ ᛫ ᚦᛅᛁᛦ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚱ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᚱ ᛁᛋᛅ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᚦᛁᚾᚬ ᛫ ᛅᛒᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚢᚾᚬ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᚼᚬᚾᛋ ᛋᛅᛚᚢ
translit: rontr auk riki ' auk kuþrun ' þaiR bruþr ' litu r isa stain þino ' abtiR ' bruno ' faþur sin ' kuþ hialbi hons salu
norse: "Þróndr/"Randr ok "Ríki(?) ok "Guðrún, þeir brœðr létu r[e]isa stein þenna eptir "Brúna, fôður sinn. "Guð hjalpi hans sálu.
english: Þróndr/Randr and Ríki(?) and Guðrún, these brothers had this stone raised in memory of Brúni, their father. May God help his soul.

runes: ᚼᛅᚱᛚᛅᛁᚠ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚦᚢᚱᚴᛅᚱᚦᚱ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛅᛏ ᛭ ᛋᛅᛒᛁ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛁᛋ ᛋᛏᚢᚱᚦᛁ ᛭ ᛅᚢᛋᛏᚱ ᛭ ᛋᚴᛁᛒᛁ ᛭ ᛘᛅᚦ ᛁᚴᚢᛅᚱᛁ ᛅ ᛅᛋᚴᛅᛚᛅᛏ
translit: harlaif × auk × þurkarþr × litu × raisa × stain × þina at × sabi faþur sin × is sturþi × austr × skibi × maþ ikuari a askalat
norse: "Herleif ok "Þorgerðr/"Þorgarðr létu reisa stein þenna at "Sæbjôrn, fôður sinn. Er stýrði austr skipi með "Ingvari á "Eistaland(?)/"Serkland[i](?).
english: Herleif and Þorgerðr/Þorgarðr had this stone raised in memory of Sæbjôrn, their father, who steered a ship east with Ingvarr to Estonia(?)/Serkland(?).

runes: ᛅᚤᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚠᚱᛅᚤᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚱᛅ ᛁᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᛅᛁᛋᛏᛅ ᛬ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᛅᛋᚴᛂᚱ ᛬ ᛒᚢ ᛅ ᛬ ᛬ ᛂᚾ ᛬ ᛋᚾᛅᚱᛁ ᛬ ᛁᛅᚴ

english: §A Eysteinn and Freysteinn raised the stone in memory of Eisti, their father, and ... §B Ásgerðr in memory of her husbandman. And Snari cut.

runes: ᚦᚬᚱ ᛫ ᚬᚴ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚱᛁᚦ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚴᛁᛅᚱᛅ ᛘᛂᚱᚴᛁ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛫ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚼᚦᚬᚱ ᛫ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛫ ᛒᛂᚱᚼᛁ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚢᛚᚢ ᛫ ᚼᛅᚾᛋ
translit: þor · ok · siriþ · litu · kiara merki · eftiR · sun sin · sihþor · kuþ · berhi · siulu · hans

english: Þórðr/Þórðr/Þorn and Sigríðr had the landmark made in memory of their son Sigþórr(?)/Sigþorn(?). May God save his soul.

runes: ᛅ ᚾᛁᛚᛁ ᛚᛁ ᛁᚦ ᛬ ᚴᛁᛅ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᚠᛁᚾᚢᛁᚦᚱ ᛬ ᚬᚴ ᛬ ᛁᚱ ᛘᚢᛏ

... in memory of Ey-... ... his father ...

english: Ulfr and Herbjôrn and Nesbjôrn and Hemingr had the stone raised in memory of Borgulf, their father.

norse: "Kylfingr lét reisa stein at "Nesbjôrn, fôður si[nn], ok "Gillaug at bónda sinn.
english: Kylfingr had the stone raised in memory of Nesbjôrn, his father; and Gillaug in memory of her husbandman.

english: Ígull and Bjôrn had the stone raised in memory of Þorsteinn, their father.

runes: ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚠᛋᛏᚴᛁᚱ ᛭ ᛅᚢ ᚢᛁᛘᚬᚾᛏᛦ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋ

norse: "Saxi lét stein hôggva ok brú gera ept[ir] "..., móður sína. "Sveinn hjó.
english: Saxi had the stone cut and the bridge made in memory of ... his mother. Sveinn cut.
Ásbjôrn(?) cut(?) the runes(?)
... in memory of Steinn, brother ...

runes: ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚴᚢᛁᚴᚱ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛂᛁᚾ ᛭ ᛂᚠᛏ
translit: auk × kuikr × litu × raisa × stein × eft

norse: "Þorkell ok "Gísl [l]étu reis[a stein] þenna eptir fôður sinn "Gans[a](?)/"Knas[a](?). "Gu[ð] hjalpi ônd hans.
english: Þorkell and Gísl had this stone raised in memory of their father Gansi(?)/Knasi(?). May God help his spirit.

runes: ᚦ ᚴᛚ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛭ ᚴᛁᛋᛚ ᛭ ᛚᛅᛏᛅ ᛭ ᚱᛁᛋᛅ ᛫ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛁᚾ ᛫ ᛂᚠᛏᛦ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚢᚦᚢᚱ ᛫ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛋᛏᚤᚱᛒᛁᚢᚾ ᛭ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛋᛂᚠᛅᚱᛁ ᚢᛁᛋᛂᛏᛁ ᚼᛁᚢᚴ
translit: þ kl + auk + kisl + lata + risa ' þina + stin · eftR · bruþur · sin styrbiun × auk sefari uiseti hiuk

english: Þorkell and Gísl have raised this stone in memory of their brother Styrbjôrn, and Sæfari (also raised). Véseti cut.

runes: ᛭ ᛁᚾᚴᛁᚠᛅᛋᛏᚱ ᛭ ᛚᛁᛏ ᛭ ᚱᛅᛁᛋᛅ ᛭ ᛋᛏᛅᛁᚾ ᛭ ᚦᛁᚾᛅ ᛅᛏ ᚦᚬᚱᚴᛁᛚ ᛭ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛅᛏ ᚴᚢᚾᛁᛚᛏᛁ ᛘᚬᚦᚢᚱ ᛋᛁᚾᛅ ᚦᛅᚢ ᛏᚱᚢᚴᚾᛅᚦᚢ ᛭ ᛒᛅᚦᛁ
translit: × inkifastr + lit × raisa × stain × þina at þorkil + faþur sin auk at kunilti moþur sina þau truknaþu × baþi
norse: "Ingifastr lét reisa stein þenna at "Þorkel, fôður sinn, ok at "Gunnhildi, móður sína. Þau druknuðu bæði.
english: Ingifastr had this stone raised in memory of Þorkell, his father, and in memory of Gunnhildr, his mother. They both drowned.

runes: ᛁᚴᚢ ᚱᛒᛁᛅᚱᚾ ᛫ ᛚᛁᛏᚢ ᛫ ᚴᛁᛅᚱᛅ ᛫ ᛒᚱᚢ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚦᛁᛅᚴᚾ ᛫ ᚠᛅᚦᚢᚱ
translit: iku rbiarn · litu · kiara · bru at · þiakn · faþur
english: Ing-... ... Þorbjôrn had the bridge made in memory of Þegn, their father.

runes: ᛭ ᛋᚢᛅᚱᛏᚼᚬᚠᚦᛁ ᛬ ᛚᛂᛏ ᛬ ᚱᛂᛁᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛋᛏᛂᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚦᛂᚾᛏᛋᛅ ᛬ ᛂᚠᛏᛁᛦ ᛬ ᚬᚾᚢᛏ ᛬ ᛋᚢᚾ ᛬ ᛋᛁᚾ ᛬ ᚴᚢᚦ ᛬ ᚼᛁᛅᛚᛒᛁ ᛬ ᛅᛏ ᛫ ᚼᛅᚾᛋ ᛬ ᛅᚢᚴ ᛬ ᛅᛚᚢᛘ ᛫ ᚴᚱᛁᛋᛏᚾᚢᛘ

english: Ágoti and Ôzurr and Bjôrn raised this stone in memory of Nokki, a good valiant man.

norse: "Jógeirr ok "Fastgeirr ok "Auðríkr/"Eyríkr létu rétta stein eptir "Borggeir, fôður sinn frægan. Sjalfr hjó "Auðríkr/"Eyríkr eptir sinn fôður rúnar þessar. Ráði sá kunni.
english: Jógeirr and Fastgeirr and Auðríkr/Eyríkr had the stone erected in memory of Borggeirr, their acclaimed father. Auðríkr/Eyríkr cut these runes himself in memory of his father. Interpret, he who can.

english: §A Geirfríðr(?) and Geirmarr had (this) cut §B in memory of Auðmundr. Grímr Skald cut.

english: Andsvarr/Ásvarðr/Ásvôr had the stone raised in memory of Tryggr, his son; Áskell and Stóðkell the Old erected in memory of Stóðbjôrn, their father.
Freysteinn had (this) raised/erected ... Skarði(?) father ...

norse: Þau(?) "Eyríkr(?)/"Auðríkr(?) frændr rei[st]u s[tein epti]r "Helga, bróður sinn. En "Sassurr drap hann ok gerði niðingsverk, sveik félaga sinn. "Guð hjalp ônd hans.
english: Eyríkr(?)/Auðríkr(?) and his kinsmen, they raised the stone in memory of Helgi, their brother. And Sassurr killed him and made (= did) a villainous deed, betrayed his partner. God help his spirit.

norse: "Steinhildr lét rétta stein þenna eptir "Viðbjôrn "Grikkfara, bónda sinn. "Guð hjalpi hans sálu ok "Guðs <u> móðir. "Ásmundr "Kára sonr markaði.
english: Steinhildr had this stone erected in memory of Viðbjôrn, her husband, a traveller to Greece. May God and God's mother help his soul. Ásmundr Kári' son marked.

english: Gerðarr and Ulfr and Holmbjôrn and Ábjôrn and Rúni, they had the stone cut in memory of Jarl, their father; Arnfríðr in memory of her husbandman.

english: This is in memory of Signjóti. His son Sigviðr made the runes. Þorgautr carved.

norse: "Sigríðr l[ét] ... <huki> frænda sínum. En hér átti ríkr ... ... En "Œpir risti.
english: Sigríðr had ... her kinsman. And here the powerful owned ... And Œpir carved.

english: Ingulfr and Eyndr, they had the stone raised in memory of Ingjaldr, their brother and Gunnulfr's son.
Gunnarr

norse: "Ásdjarfr lét reisa stein eptir "Ásfast, bróður sinn.
english: Ásdjarfr had the stone raised in memory of Ásfastr, his brother.

translit: ernfriþ ok is st litu · ra a · sten · eftiR · kunar · faþur · sin · ok · kitulbiurn · ok · kilok · at · bonta sin fastulfr ok · iyruntr · at broþur sin
norse: "Ernfríðr ok ... létu re[is]a stein eptir "Gunnar, fôður sinn, ok "Ketilbjôrn, ok "Gillaug at bónda sinn. "Fastulfr ok "Jôrundr at bróður sinn.
english: Ernfríðr and ... had the stone raised in memory of Gunnarr, their father; and Ketilbjôrn and Gillaug in memory of their husbandman; Fastulfr and Jôrundr in memory of their brother.

english: Sigviðr, traveller to England, raised this stone in memory of Védjarfr, (his) father ...

english: Ingiþóra had this stone raised in memory of her father Sigtryggr, and (so did) Ragnfastr, her son. Her brother was called Ragnarr.

norse: "Véseti ok "Líkviðr ok "Ríkviðr létu reisa stein at "Holmgeir(?)/"Végeir(?), fôður. "Œpir risti.
english: Véseti and Líkviðr and Ríkviðr had the stone raised in memory of Holmgeirr(?)/Végeirr(?), (their) father. Œpir carved.

english: Karl had the stone raised in memory of Végeirr, his father. He was Styfjaldr's son and Gullaug's sister's son.

norse: "Ketill ok "Gyríðr létu reisa stein þenna eptir "Þorstein, son sinn. "Viði/"Víði ok "Ríkviðr þeir reistu stein eptir bróður sinn. "Guð hjalpi ônd "Þorsteins.
english: Ketill and Gyríðr had this stone raised in memory of Þorsteinn, their son. Viði/Víði and Ríkviðr, they raised the stone in memory of their brother. May God help Þorsteinn's spirit.

norse: §A Ept "Vámóð standa rúnar þær. En "Varinn fáði, faðir, ept feigjan son. Sôgum múgminni/ungmenni þat, hverjar valraufar væri tvær þær, svát tolf sinnum væri numnar at valraufu, báðar saman á ýmissum mônnum. Þat sôgum annat, hverr fyrir níu ôldum án yrði fjôr með "Hreiðgotum, auk dó með hann um sakar. Réð "Þjóðríkr hinn þormóði, stillir flotna, strôndu "Hreiðmarar. Sitr nú gôrr á §B gota sínum, skildi um fatlaðr, skati "Mæringa. §C Þat sôgum tolfta, hvar hestr sé "Gunnar etu véttvangi á, konungar tveir tigir svát á liggja. Þat sôgum þrettánda, hverir tveir tigir konungar sæti at "Sjólundi fjóra vetr at fjórum nôfnum, bornir fjórum brœðrum. "Valkar fimm, "Ráðulfs synir, "Hreiðulfar fimm, "Rugulfs synir, "Háislar fimm, "Hôrðs synir, "Gunnmundar/"Kynmundar fimm, "Bjarnar synir. Nú'k m[inni] m[eð] ôllu [se]gi. Einhverr ... [svá]t ... eptir frá. Sôgum múgminni/ungmenni þat, hvar "Ingoldinga væri goldinn at kvánar húsli. Sôgum múgminni/ungmenni, hveim sé borinn niðr drengi. "Vilinn er þat. Knúa/knýja knátti jôtun. "Vilinn er þat ... §D [S]ôgum múgminni/ungmenni: "Þórr. §E "Sibbi véaveri §C ól nírœðr.
english: §A In memory of Vámóðr stand these runes. And Varinn coloured them, the father, in memory of his dead son. I say the folktale / to the young men, which the two war-booties were, which twelve times were taken as war-booty, both together from various men. I say this second, who nine generations ago lost his life with the Hreidgoths; and died with them for his guilt. Þjóðríkr the bold, chief of sea-warriors, ruled over the shores of the Hreiðsea. Now he sits armed on §B his Goth(ic horse), his shield strapped, the prince of the Mærings. §C I say this the twelfth, where the horse of Gunnr sees fodder on the battlefield, where twenty kings lie. This I say as thirteenth, which twenty kings sat on Sjólund for four winters, of four names, born of four brothers: five Valkis, sons of Ráðulfr, five Hreiðulfrs, sons of Rugulfr, five Háisl, sons of Hôrðr, five Gunnmundrs/Kynmundrs, sons of Bjôrn. Now I say the tales in full. Someone ... I say the folktale / to the young men, which of the line of Ingold was repaid by a wife's sacrifice. I say the folktale / to the young men, to whom is born a relative, to a valiant man. It is Vélinn. He could crush a giant. It is Vélinn ... §D I say the folktale / to the young men: Þórr. §E Sibbi of Vé, §C nonagenarian, begot (a son).

Þorkell carved the runes.
